# S4E Design System

> React + Tailwind v4 component library and design tokens for the S4E security product (scans, assets, findings, severity). Version 1.3.1. 24 copy-paste components (shadcn-style: you own the code), themed with `s4e-*` CSS variables in light and dark mode, targeting WCAG 2.2 AA and the WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices (remaining gaps are listed per component).

## Rules for AI agents

1. **Use the existing components.** Copy the source from `/components/<slug>.tsx.txt` into `components/ui/<slug>.tsx`. Don't recreate a component that already exists, and don't restyle it from scratch.
2. **Never hard-code colours, shadows or z-indexes.** Use the `s4e-*` tokens through Tailwind utilities (`bg-s4e-surface-app`, `text-s4e-text-secondary`, `border-s4e-border-default`, `shadow-s4e-lg`, `z-modal`). Every token is defined in `theme.css`.
3. **Prefer semantic tokens over scale primitives.** Borders: `border-s4e-border-default` / `-strong` / `-focus` / `-error`. Tints: `bg-s4e-bg-subtle`, `bg-s4e-bg-{brand,info,success,warning,error}-subtle`. Focus: `ring-s4e-focus-ring` (`-error` for destructive). Text: `text-s4e-text-*`. Surfaces: `bg-s4e-surface-*`. Use `s4e-scale-<hue>-<step>` / `s4e-neutral-*` primitives only when the hue itself is the meaning (severity, data series). Use `text-s4e-text-disabled` only for disabled controls; it fails contrast for normal text.
4. **Follow each component's "When to use / When not to use".** For example, a destructive confirm is a `Modal` with `Button intent="destructive"`, a vulnerability level is always `SeverityBadge`, and navigation is a link, not a `Button`.
5. **Accessibility is part of the API.** Pass `label` to form fields, `aria-label` to icon-only buttons and to `RadioGroup` / `TabsList`, and an `aria-label` with the takeaway to charts. Don't remove the focus styles.
6. **Respect the status.** `deprecated` components (Banner) must not be used in new code; follow the migration note. `alpha` components may change.
7. **Check "Known gaps"** in each doc before assuming a behaviour exists.
8. **Naming:** states are lowercase (`state="error"`), colour families are `tone` (not `color`).
9. **Lint your output.** Add [eslint-plugin-s4e](/eslint-plugin-s4e.mjs) (`s4e.configs.recommended`): it rejects hard-coded colours and unlabeled icon-only buttons, and autofixes primitives to semantic tokens. Fix every error before finishing.

## Setup

- **Requirements:** React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, `clsx`, `tailwind-merge` and `lucide-react`. `Tabs` has no extra deps; `Modal` uses `react-dom`'s `createPortal`.
- **Lint guardrails:** save [eslint-plugin-s4e.mjs](/eslint-plugin-s4e.mjs) in your repo and add `import s4e from "./eslint-plugin-s4e.mjs"` + `s4e.configs.recommended` to `eslint.config.mjs` (flat config).
- **Tokens and theme:** add [theme.css](/theme.css) after `@import "tailwindcss";`. Dark mode is enabled with `.dark` or `[data-s4e-theme="dark"]` on an ancestor.
- **`cn()` helper** at `@/lib/utils`:

```ts
import { clsx, type ClassValue } from "clsx"
import { twMerge } from "tailwind-merge"

export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) {
  return twMerge(clsx(inputs))
}
```

## Index

- Alert (`alert`, Atom, stable)
- Badge · Tag (`badge-tag`, Atom, stable)
- Banner (`banner`, Atom, deprecated)
- Button (`button`, Atom, stable)
- Checkbox (`checkbox`, Atom, beta)
- Select (`select`, Atom, beta)
- Severity Badge (`severity-badge`, Atom, stable)
- Skeleton (`skeleton`, Atom, beta)
- Spinner (`spinner`, Atom, alpha)
- Switch · Radio (`switch-radio`, Atom, stable)
- Text Field (`text-field`, Atom, stable)
- Textarea (`textarea`, Atom, stable)
- Toast · Tooltip (`toast-tooltip`, Atom, stable)
- Breadcrumb (`breadcrumb`, Molecule, stable)
- Filter Bar (`filter-bar`, Molecule, stable)
- Search Bar (`search-bar`, Molecule, stable)
- Tabs (`tabs`, Molecule, stable)
- Cards (`cards`, Organism, stable)
- Chart (`chart`, Organism, stable)
- Data Table (`data-table`, Organism, stable)
- Empty State (`empty-state`, Organism, stable)
- Gauge (`gauge`, Organism, stable)
- Modal (`modal`, Organism, stable)
- Text Space (`text-space`, Organism, stable)

## Theme CSS (`theme.css`)

```css
/* S4E Design System v1.3.1 — theme
 * Auto-generated by scripts/export-llms.js from app/globals.css — do not edit by hand.
 *
 * Requires Tailwind CSS v4. Import after Tailwind:
 *   @import "tailwindcss";
 *   @import "./theme.css";
 * Light: :root or [data-s4e-theme="light"]. Dark: .dark or [data-s4e-theme="dark"].
 */

@custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *));

/* ===================================================================
   S4E DESIGN SYSTEM — COLOR TOKENS
   Light values: :root and [data-s4e-theme="light"]
   Dark values:  .dark and [data-s4e-theme="dark"]
   =================================================================== */

:root,
[data-s4e-theme="light"] {

  --s4e-severity-info: #7dafd6;
  --s4e-severity-low: #63a100;

  --s4e-severity-high: #d13d2e;

  --s4e-text-primary:     #121f28;

  --s4e-text-brand:   var(--s4e-brand-primary-600);    /* = #0F69A9 light — 5.81:1, AA */
  --s4e-text-success: #2f7d2c;                         /* deep readable green — 5.13:1, AA */

  --s4e-text-error:   #f87171; /* coral red — 6.89:1, AA (replaces washed pink) */
  --s4e-text-info:    #67a9dc; /* medium blue — 7.52:1, AAA (replaces pale wash) */

  /* Button hover-overlay backgrounds — flipped to dark tints so hover doesn't appear as a bright patch on dark page surfaces */
```

## Components

<!-- ===== Alert (alert) ===== -->

---
title: Alert
slug: alert
category: Atom
status: stable
source: components/ui/alert.tsx
styleguide: /styleguide/alert
figma: TBD
apg: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/alert/
---

# Alert

An inline message tied to a page or section. It communicates a status that persists until the condition changes or the user dismisses it.

## Overview

### When to use
- A form or section-level error ("3 fields need attention").
- A persistent warning about the current context ("This asset hasn't been scanned in 30 days").
- A success message that should stay visible after a page change.

### When not to use
- Transient feedback on an action → [Toast](./toast-tooltip.md).
- Product-wide announcements at the top of the app → [Banner](./banner.md) (deprecated). Use a full-width Alert at the top of the layout instead.
- Field-level errors → the field's `errorText`.

## Anatomy

```
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ① ⓘ  ② Title                          ⑤ ✕     │
│       ③ Description text…                     │
│       ④ [Action]                              │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

1. **Icon**: fixed per variant (Info, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, XCircle).
2. **Title** (optional).
3. **Description**: `children`.
4. **Action** (optional): a link or small button.
5. **Dismiss** (optional): `aria-label="Dismiss"`.

## Variants

| `variant` | Use for |
|---|---|
| `info` *(default)* | Neutral context, tips |
| `success` | Confirmation that persists |
| `warning` | Potential problem, still possible to continue |
| `error` | Something failed or is blocking |

## States

| State | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Visible | Stays until dismissed or the condition clears |
| Dismissed | Removed; `onDismiss` fires. Persist the dismissal if it shouldn't come back. |

## Content guidelines
- Title: a short summary ("Scan failed"). Description: cause + next step ("The target refused connections. Check the firewall allow-list.").
- Keep the action label a verb ("Retry scan", "View logs").

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Place the alert next to what it's about | Stack several alerts. Combine them into one with a list. |
| Make `error` alerts non-dismissible while the error persists | Let users dismiss an unresolved blocking error |

## Accessibility

**Pattern:** [APG — Alert](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/alert/)

- Root has `role="alert"` (assertive live region). Screen readers interrupt to read it **when it's inserted**.
- `role="alert"` is right for `error` / `warning` that appear in response to an action. For `info` / `success`, or alerts present on page load, `role="status"` is less disruptive.
- The dismiss button is a native `<button>` with `aria-label`. Move focus somewhere sensible after dismissal.
- The icon is decorative; the variant meaning should also appear in the title text.

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Background | `s4e-scale-{blue,green,yellow,red}-50` |
| Border | `s4e-scale-*-200` |
| Text / icon | `s4e-text-info`, `s4e-text-success`, `s4e-text-warning`, `s4e-text-error` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma property | Prop | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Variant | `variant` | Info · Success · Warning · Error |
| Title | `title` | text / none |
| Dismissible | `dismissible` | true / false |
| Action | `action` | slot |

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `"info" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "error"` | `"info"` | Colour + icon |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | — | Heading |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | Description |
| `action` | `ReactNode` | — | Action slot |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows ✕ |
| `onDismiss` | `() => void` | — | Called on ✕ |
| …rest | `HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Forwarded |

## Examples

```tsx
<Alert variant="error" title="Scan failed" action={<Button size="sm" variant="outline" intent="destructive">Retry</Button>}>
  The target refused connections. Check the firewall allow-list.
</Alert>
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] `role="alert"` is hard-coded for every variant. Add a `live` prop or use `status` for info / success.
- [ ] No full-width / page-level layout option to replace Banner.

## Related
- [Toast](./toast-tooltip.md) · [Banner](./banner.md) · [Empty State](./empty-state.md)

### Source — `components/ui/alert.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { CheckCircle2, Info, AlertTriangle, OctagonAlert, X } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — Alert
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/alert.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 *   • lucide-react for icons.
 */

type Variant = "info" | "success" | "warning" | "error";

export interface AlertProps extends Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title"> {
  variant?:     Variant;
  title?:       React.ReactNode;
  dismissible?: boolean;
  action?:      React.ReactNode;
  onDismiss?:   () => void;
}

type VariantConfig = {
  bg:        string;
  border:    string;
  text:      string;
  title:     string;
  iconClass: string;
  icon:      React.ComponentType<{ size?: number; className?: string }>;
};

const VARIANT_CLASS: Record<Variant, VariantConfig> = {
  info: {
    bg:        "bg-s4e-bg-info-subtle",
    border:    "border-s4e-scale-blue-200",
    text:      "text-s4e-text-info",
    title:     "text-s4e-text-info",
    iconClass: "text-s4e-text-info",
    icon:      Info,
  },
  success: {
    bg:        "bg-s4e-bg-success-subtle",
    border:    "border-s4e-scale-green-200",
    text:      "text-s4e-text-success",
    title:     "text-s4e-text-success",
    iconClass: "text-s4e-text-success",
    icon:      CheckCircle2,
  },
  warning: {
    bg:        "bg-s4e-bg-warning-subtle",
    border:    "border-s4e-scale-yellow-200",
    text:      "text-s4e-text-warning",
    title:     "text-s4e-text-warning",
    iconClass: "text-s4e-text-warning",
    icon:      AlertTriangle,
  },
  error: {
    bg:        "bg-s4e-bg-error-subtle",
    border:    "border-s4e-scale-red-200",
    text:      "text-s4e-text-error",
    title:     "text-s4e-text-error",
    iconClass: "text-s4e-text-error",
    icon:      OctagonAlert,
  },
};

export const Alert = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, AlertProps>(
  (
    {
      variant     = "info",
      title,
      dismissible = false,
      action,
      onDismiss,
      className,
      children,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(true);
    const cfg = VARIANT_CLASS[variant];
    const Icon = cfg.icon;
    if (!open) return null;

    const handleDismiss = () => {
      setOpen(false);
      onDismiss?.();
    };

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role="alert"
        className={cn(
          "flex items-start gap-3 rounded-md border px-4 py-3",
          cfg.bg,
          cfg.border,
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <Icon size={16} className={cn("shrink-0 mt-px", cfg.iconClass)} />
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
          {title && (
            <div className={cn("text-[14px] font-semibold leading-tight", cfg.title)}>
              {title}
            </div>
          )}
          {children && (
            <div className={cn("text-[12px] leading-relaxed", cfg.text, title && "mt-1")}>
              {children}
            </div>
          )}
          {action && <div className="mt-2.5">{action}</div>}
        </div>
        {dismissible && (
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label="Dismiss"
            onClick={handleDismiss}
            className={cn(
              "shrink-0 p-1 -m-1 rounded hover:bg-s4e-neutral-divider-10 cursor-pointer",
              cfg.text,
            )}
          >
            <X size={14} />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  },
);
Alert.displayName = "Alert";
```

<!-- ===== Badge · Tag (badge-tag) ===== -->

---
title: Badge · Tag
slug: badge-tag
category: Atom
status: stable
source: components/ui/badge-tag.tsx
styleguide: /styleguide/badge-tag
figma: TBD
apg: N/A (static content)
---

# Badge · Tag

A small pill that labels an object with a status (**Badge**) or a category (**Tag**). It's the same primitive; Badge shows a status dot by default.

## Overview

### When to use
- **Badge:** the status of an item ("Active", "Failed", "Pending").
- **Tag:** a classification or metadata ("Production", "API", "EU").

### When not to use
- Vulnerability severity → [Severity Badge](./severity-badge.md), which has the canonical severity colours.
- Counts on navigation or icons → a count bubble (see Filter Bar's `count`).
- Anything clickable → a button or a filter pill ([Filter Bar](./filter-bar.md)).

## Anatomy

```
╭──────────────╮
│ ① ● ② Label  │
╰──────────────╯
```

1. **Dot** (optional, 7px): left or right.
2. **Label**: 12px / 500.

## Variants

| `tone` | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `success` | Healthy, completed, passed |
| `warning` | Needs attention, degraded |
| `error` | Failed, blocked |
| `info` | Informational, in progress |
| `primary` | Brand / highlighted |
| `neutral` | Default, inactive, archived |

`outlined` swaps the filled tint for a 1px border, for use on tinted surfaces.

## States
Static. No hover, focus or disabled states.

## Content guidelines
- 1–2 words, sentence case. Status: adjective or past participle ("Running", "Failed").
- Use the same word for the same state everywhere. Keep a shared status vocabulary.

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Pair colour with a word | Rely on colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1) |
| Limit to 1–2 badges per row | Stack 4 badges in a table cell |

## Accessibility
- Renders a `<span>`, read as plain text. The dot is `aria-hidden`.
- If the badge sits next to an ambiguous value, add context with visually hidden text ("Status: Failed").
- Contrast: label colours (`*-600` / `*-700` on `*-50`) are chosen to pass 4.5:1.

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Filled bg | `s4e-scale-{green,yellow,red,blue}-50`, `s4e-brand-primary-50`, `s4e-bg-subtle` |
| Label | `s4e-scale-*-600` (yellow `-700`), `s4e-brand-primary-600`, `s4e-text-secondary` |
| Dot | `s4e-scale-*-500`, `s4e-brand-primary-500`, `s4e-neutral-grey-400` |
| Outlined border | `s4e-scale-*-200`, `s4e-brand-primary-200`, `s4e-border-default` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma property | Prop | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Tone | `tone` | Success · Warning · Error · Info · Primary · Neutral |
| Dot | `showDot` | true / false (Badge default true, Tag default false) |
| Dot position | `dotPosition` | Left · Right |
| Outlined | `outlined` | true / false |

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tone` | `"warning" \| "error" \| "success" \| "neutral" \| "info" \| "primary"` | `"neutral"` | Colour family |
| `color` | same as `tone` | — | **Deprecated** alias of `tone` |
| `showDot` | `boolean` | Badge `true` / Tag `false` | Status dot |
| `dotPosition` | `"left" \| "right"` | `"left"` | Dot side |
| `outlined` | `boolean` | `false` | Border instead of fill |
| …rest | `HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>` | — | Forwarded |

Exports: `Badge`, `Tag` (`TagProps = BadgeProps`).

## Examples

```tsx
<Badge tone="success">Active</Badge>
<Badge tone="error">Failed</Badge>
<Tag tone="info">Production</Tag>
<Tag outlined>EU</Tag>
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] The styleguide showcase (`sections/badge-tag/`) still uses `s4e-scale-*-300` border tokens, which don't exist (the scale has no 300 step), so its outlined badges have no coloured border. `components/ui` was fixed to `-200`; decide whether the scale needs a 300 step.
- [ ] No size scale (`sm` for tables).
- [ ] No removable-tag variant (✕ button with an accessible name).

## Related
- [Severity Badge](./severity-badge.md) · [Filter Bar](./filter-bar.md)

### Source — `components/ui/badge-tag.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — Badge & Tag
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/badge-tag.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 *
 * Badge — status pill (defaults to a colored dot).
 * Tag   — label pill (same primitive, no dot by default).
 */

type Tone        = "warning" | "error" | "success" | "neutral" | "info" | "primary";
type DotPosition = "left" | "right";

export interface BadgeProps extends Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, "color"> {
  tone?:        Tone;
  /** @deprecated Use `tone` (consistent with Banner, Checkbox, Spinner). */
  color?:       Tone;
  showDot?:     boolean;
  dotPosition?: DotPosition;
  outlined?:    boolean;
}

export type TagProps = BadgeProps;

type ColorConfig = {
  bg:     string;
  text:   string;
  dot:    string;
  border: string;
};

const TONE_CLASS: Record<Tone, ColorConfig> = {
  warning: {
    bg:     "bg-s4e-bg-warning-subtle",
    text:   "text-s4e-scale-yellow-700",
    dot:    "bg-s4e-scale-yellow-500",
    border: "border-s4e-scale-yellow-200",
  },
  error: {
    bg:     "bg-s4e-bg-error-subtle",
    text:   "text-s4e-text-error",
    dot:    "bg-s4e-scale-red-500",
    border: "border-s4e-scale-red-200",
  },
  success: {
    bg:     "bg-s4e-bg-success-subtle",
    text:   "text-s4e-scale-green-600",
    dot:    "bg-s4e-scale-green-500",
    border: "border-s4e-scale-green-200",
  },
  neutral: {
    bg:     "bg-s4e-bg-subtle",
    text:   "text-s4e-text-secondary",
    dot:    "bg-s4e-neutral-grey-400",
    border: "border-s4e-border-default",
  },
  info: {
    bg:     "bg-s4e-bg-info-subtle",
    text:   "text-s4e-scale-blue-600",
    dot:    "bg-s4e-scale-blue-500",
    border: "border-s4e-scale-blue-200",
  },
  primary: {
    bg:     "bg-s4e-bg-brand-subtle",
    text:   "text-s4e-brand-primary-600",
    dot:    "bg-s4e-brand-primary-500",
    border: "border-s4e-brand-primary-200",
  },
};

const BASE =
  "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[12px] font-medium";

function renderPill(
  {
    tone,
    color,
    showDot,
    dotPosition = "left",
    outlined    = false,
    className,
    children,
    ...props
  }: BadgeProps,
  ref: React.Ref<HTMLSpanElement>,
  defaultShowDot: boolean,
) {
  const cfg = TONE_CLASS[tone ?? color ?? "neutral"];
  const dotVisible = showDot ?? defaultShowDot;
  const dot = (
    <span
      aria-hidden
      className={cn("inline-block w-[7px] h-[7px] rounded-full shrink-0", cfg.dot)}
    />
  );

  return (
    <span
      ref={ref}
      className={cn(
        BASE,
        outlined
          ? cn("border bg-transparent", cfg.border, cfg.text)
          : cn(cfg.bg, cfg.text),
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {dotVisible && dotPosition === "left" && dot}
      <span>{children}</span>
      {dotVisible && dotPosition === "right" && dot}
    </span>
  );
}

export const Badge = React.forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, BadgeProps>(
  (props, ref) => renderPill(props, ref, true),
);
Badge.displayName = "Badge";

export const Tag = React.forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, TagProps>(
  (props, ref) => renderPill(props, ref, false),
);
Tag.displayName = "Tag";
```

<!-- ===== Banner (banner) ===== -->

---
title: Banner
slug: banner
category: Atom
status: deprecated
source: components/ui/banner.tsx
styleguide: /styleguide/banner
figma: TBD
apg: N/A
---

# Banner

> **Deprecated.** Don't use Banner in new designs or code. It will be removed in the next major release.
> **Migrate to:** a full-width [Alert](./alert.md) placed at the top of the page layout (for system messages), or an in-content promo card (for marketing). See *Migration* below.

A full-width strip at the top of the app for product-wide announcements, promotions or warnings.

## Why it's deprecated
_Draft rationale, inferred from the code. Confirm with design before publishing._
- It overlaps with Alert (warning) and with in-content cards (promo), which makes it unclear which to use.
- Dark, saturated full-width bars compete with the top bar and with page-level primary actions.
- Its dismiss state isn't persisted, so it reappears on every load.

## Migration

| Banner usage | Replace with |
|---|---|
| `tone="warning"` (maintenance, quota) | `<Alert variant="warning" dismissible>` at the top of the page content |
| `tone="neutral"` (announcement) | `<Alert variant="info" dismissible>` |
| `tone="promo"` (upsell, new feature) | An in-content card or an empty-state slot, not a global bar |

```tsx
// Before
<Banner tone="warning" message="Scheduled maintenance Sunday 02:00 UTC" cta={{ label: "Details", href: "/status" }} />

// After
<Alert variant="warning" dismissible onDismiss={persistDismiss}
  action={<a href="/status">Details</a>}>
  Scheduled maintenance Sunday 02:00 UTC
</Alert>
```

## Anatomy (for reference)

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ① 📣  ② Message                         ③ [CTA]     ④ ✕     │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

① tone icon · ② message · ③ optional CTA link · ④ dismiss (`aria-label="Dismiss"`).

## Variants (for reference)

| `tone` | Background |
|---|---|
| `neutral` *(default)* | `s4e-btn-neutral-800` |
| `promo` | `s4e-btn-primary-600` |
| `warning` | `s4e-scale-yellow-500` |

## Accessibility
- No landmark or live-region role. If it's kept temporarily, wrap it in `<section aria-label="Announcement">`.

## API (for reference)

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `tone` | `"neutral" \| "promo" \| "warning"` | `"neutral"` |
| `message` | `ReactNode` | — (required) |
| `cta` | `{ label: string; href?: string }` | — |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` | `true` |
| `onDismiss` | `() => void` | — |

## Related
- [Alert](./alert.md)

### Source — `components/ui/banner.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { Megaphone, Sparkles, AlertTriangle, X } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — Banner
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/banner.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 *   • lucide-react for icons.
 */

type Tone = "neutral" | "promo" | "warning";

export interface BannerCta {
  label: string;
  href?: string;
}

export interface BannerProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  tone?:        Tone;
  message:      React.ReactNode;
  cta?:         BannerCta;
  dismissible?: boolean;
  onDismiss?:   () => void;
}

type ToneConfig = {
  bg:    string;
  text:  string;
  hover: string;
  icon:  React.ComponentType<{ size?: number; className?: string }>;
};

const TONE_CLASS: Record<Tone, ToneConfig> = {
  neutral: {
    bg:    "bg-s4e-btn-neutral-800",
    text:  "text-s4e-text-white",
    hover: "hover:bg-s4e-text-white/10",
    icon:  Megaphone,
  },
  promo: {
    bg:    "bg-s4e-btn-primary-600",
    text:  "text-s4e-text-white",
    hover: "hover:bg-s4e-text-white/10",
    icon:  Sparkles,
  },
  warning: {
    bg:    "bg-s4e-scale-yellow-500",
    text:  "text-s4e-btn-neutral-800",
    hover: "hover:bg-s4e-btn-neutral-800/10",
    icon:  AlertTriangle,
  },
};

export const Banner = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, BannerProps>(
  (
    {
      tone        = "neutral",
      message,
      cta,
      dismissible = true,
      onDismiss,
      className,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(true);
    const cfg = TONE_CLASS[tone];
    const Icon = cfg.icon;
    if (!open) return null;

    const handleDismiss = () => {
      setOpen(false);
      onDismiss?.();
    };

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5",
          cfg.bg,
          cfg.text,
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <Icon size={14} className="shrink-0" />
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 text-[12px] leading-tight">{message}</div>
        {cta && (
          <a
            href={cta.href ?? "#"}
            className="text-[11px] font-semibold underline underline-offset-2 hover:opacity-80 shrink-0"
          >
            {cta.label}
          </a>
        )}
        {dismissible && (
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label="Dismiss"
            onClick={handleDismiss}
            className={cn("shrink-0 p-1 -m-1 rounded cursor-pointer", cfg.hover)}
          >
            <X size={14} />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  },
);
Banner.displayName = "Banner";
```

<!-- ===== Button (button) ===== -->

---
title: Button
slug: button
category: Atom
status: stable
source: components/ui/button.tsx
styleguide: /styleguide/button
figma: TBD
apg: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/button/
---

# Button

Buttons trigger an action on the current page: submitting a form, opening a modal, starting a scan.

## Overview

### When to use
- To commit, start or confirm an action ("Start scan", "Save changes").
- To open an overlay that belongs to the current page (modal, drawer).

### When not to use
- To move to another page or URL. Use a link (`<a>` / Next `<Link>`) instead, even if it looks like a button. Assistive tech announces buttons and links differently.
- For a toggle between two states. Use [Switch](./switch-radio.md).
- For a choice between options. Use [Radio](./switch-radio.md), [Select](./select.md) or [Tabs](./tabs.md).

## Anatomy

```
┌──────────────────────────────┐
│ ① [icon]  ② Label  ③ [icon]  │   ④ container
└──────────────────────────────┘
```

1. **Leading icon** (optional): a lucide icon, 14–16px, passed as a child.
2. **Label** (required unless `iconOnly`): verb + noun, sentence case.
3. **Trailing icon** (optional): e.g. `ChevronDown` for a menu trigger.
4. **Container**: carries `intent` × `variant` colours, radius `md` (6px).

## Variants

`intent` sets the meaning and `variant` sets the emphasis. All 9 combinations are supported.

| intent ＼ variant | `solid` (high) | `outline` (medium) | `ghost` (low) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `primary` | The **one** main action in an area | Secondary action next to a primary | Tertiary or inline actions |
| `default` | Neutral strong action (dark UI) | "Cancel", "Back" | Toolbar actions, icon buttons |
| `destructive` | Irreversible delete / revoke, usually inside a confirm modal | Destructive action that isn't the main one | Low-emphasis remove, e.g. in lists |

**Emphasis rule:** at most one `primary solid` per view or modal (Atlassian: "use one primary call to action").

## Sizes

| Size | Height | Padding-x | Gap | Font | Use for |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sm` | 32px | 12px | 4px | 14px / 500 | Dense tables, filter bars, cards |
| `md` *(default)* | 36px | 16px | 8px | 14px / 500 | Forms, modals, page actions |
| `lg` | 44px | 20px | 8px | 14px / 500 | Hero / empty-state CTA, touch-first screens |

`iconOnly` makes the button square (32 / 36 / 44px). 44px meets the WCAG 2.5.5 target-size recommendation. 32px meets the 2.5.8 AA minimum of 24px.

## States

| State | Visual | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| Default | Per intent × variant | — |
| Hover | One step darker bg (`*-700`) or tinted bg for outline / ghost | Pointer cursor |
| Focus (keyboard) | 2px ring + 2px offset in the intent colour | Only on `:focus-visible`, never on mouse click |
| Active / pressed | Inherits hover | — |
| Loading | Label replaced by spinner | `disabled` is set while loading. Double submit is impossible. |
| Disabled | 40% opacity, `not-allowed` cursor | Not focusable. Avoid it when you can (see Do / Don't). |

## Content guidelines
- **Verb + noun**, sentence case: "Start scan", "Delete asset". Not "OK" or "Submit".
- Keep it to 1–3 words. No ending punctuation.
- A destructive label names what is destroyed: "Delete 3 assets", not "Yes".
- Pair labels in modals: primary on the right ("Delete"), `default outline` "Cancel" on the left.

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Keep the button enabled and show a validation message on click | Disable a submit button with no explanation (Atlassian: "avoid disabling buttons") |
| Give every `iconOnly` button an `aria-label` | Rely on the icon or `title` alone |
| Use `destructive` only for irreversible actions | Use red to mean "important" |
| Use one `primary solid` per area | Put two primaries side by side |
| Put a tooltip on an enabled icon button | Put a tooltip on a disabled button, because it can't be reached by keyboard |

## Accessibility

**Pattern:** [WAI-ARIA APG — Button](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/button/)

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` | Move focus to / from the button |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Activate |

- Renders a native `<button>` with `type="button"` by default. Pass `type="submit"` inside forms.
- `iconOnly` requires `aria-label`. The visible icon should be `aria-hidden`.
- For a toggle button, pass `aria-pressed`. For a menu trigger, pass `aria-haspopup` and `aria-expanded`.
- Contrast: label on `btn-primary-600` and `btn-error-600` passes 4.5:1. The focus ring is 3:1 against the surface.

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Primary bg / hover | `s4e-btn-primary-600` / `s4e-btn-primary-700` |
| Destructive bg / hover | `s4e-btn-error-600` / `s4e-btn-error-700` |
| Default solid bg / hover | `s4e-text-primary` / `s4e-neutral-grey-800` |
| Label on solid | `s4e-text-on-accent`, `s4e-text-inverse` |
| Outline / ghost label | `s4e-text-link`, `s4e-text-error`, `s4e-text-primary` |
| Outline border | `s4e-border-strong` |
| Tinted hover | `s4e-bg-brand-subtle`, `s4e-bg-error-subtle`, `s4e-bg-subtle` |
| Focus ring | `s4e-focus-ring`, `s4e-focus-ring-error`, `s4e-neutral-grey-300…500` |
| Ring offset | `s4e-surface-app` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma property | Prop | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Intent | `intent` | Default · Primary · Destructive |
| Variant | `variant` | Solid · Outline · Ghost |
| Size | `size` | SM · MD · LG |
| State = Loading | `loading` | true / false |
| Icon only | `iconOnly` | true / false |
| State = Disabled | `disabled` | true / false |

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `intent` | `"default" \| "primary" \| "destructive"` | `"primary"` | Meaning / colour family |
| `variant` | `"solid" \| "outline" \| "ghost"` | `"solid"` | Emphasis |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` | Height and padding |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a spinner and disables the button |
| `iconOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | Square button. Requires `aria-label`. |
| `type` | `"button" \| "submit" \| "reset"` | `"button"` | Native type |
| …rest | `ButtonHTMLAttributes` | — | Forwarded to `<button>`; `ref` forwarded |

## Examples

```tsx
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Trash2, Play } from "lucide-react";

<Button>Start scan</Button>
<Button intent="default" variant="outline">Cancel</Button>
<Button intent="destructive"><Trash2 size={14} aria-hidden /> Delete asset</Button>
<Button iconOnly variant="ghost" intent="default" aria-label="Run again"><Play size={16} aria-hidden /></Button>
<Button type="submit" loading={isSaving}>Save changes</Button>
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] `loading` swaps the label for a spinner, so the width jumps and screen readers lose the label. Keep the label visually hidden, overlay the spinner, and add `aria-busy`.
- [ ] No `asChild` / `href` support for link-styled buttons. Consumers hand-roll `<a>` styling.
- [ ] Hover uses primitive scale tokens (`neutral-grey-800`, `scale-red-50`). Move to semantic `bg-hover-*` tokens.
- [ ] Font size is a hard-coded `text-[14px]`. Should use a typography token.

## Related
- [Spinner](./spinner.md) · [Modal](./modal.md) · [Filter Bar](./filter-bar.md) · [Tooltip](./toast-tooltip.md)

### Source — `components/ui/button.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — Button
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/button.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 */

type Intent  = "default" | "primary" | "destructive";
type Variant = "solid"   | "outline" | "ghost";
type Size    = "sm"      | "md"      | "lg";

export interface ButtonProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  intent?:   Intent;
  variant?:  Variant;
  size?:     Size;
  loading?:  boolean;
  iconOnly?: boolean;
}

const BASE =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center font-medium rounded-md select-none whitespace-nowrap " +
  "transition-colors cursor-pointer " +
  "focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-s4e-surface-app " +
  "disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:pointer-events-none";

const SIZE_CLASS: Record<Size, string> = {
  sm: "h-8 px-3 text-[14px] gap-1",
  md: "h-9 px-4 text-[14px] gap-2",
  lg: "h-11 px-5 text-[14px] gap-2",
};

const ICON_ONLY_SIZE: Record<Size, string> = {
  sm: "w-8 h-8 p-0",
  md: "w-9 h-9 p-0",
  lg: "w-11 h-11 p-0",
};

const VARIANT_CLASS: Record<Intent, Record<Variant, string>> = {
  default: {
    solid:
      "bg-s4e-text-primary text-s4e-text-inverse " +
      "hover:bg-s4e-neutral-grey-800 " +
      "focus-visible:ring-s4e-neutral-grey-500",
    outline:
      "border border-s4e-border-strong text-s4e-text-primary bg-transparent " +
      "hover:bg-s4e-bg-subtle " +
      "focus-visible:ring-s4e-neutral-grey-400",
    ghost:
      "text-s4e-text-primary bg-transparent " +
      "hover:bg-s4e-bg-subtle " +
      "focus-visible:ring-s4e-neutral-grey-300",
  },
  primary: {
    solid:
      "bg-s4e-btn-primary-600 text-s4e-text-on-accent " +
      "hover:bg-s4e-btn-primary-700 " +
      "focus-visible:ring-s4e-focus-ring",
    outline:
      "border border-s4e-text-link text-s4e-text-link bg-transparent " +
      "hover:bg-s4e-bg-brand-subtle " +
      "focus-visible:ring-s4e-focus-ring",
    ghost:
      "text-s4e-text-link bg-transparent " +
      "hover:bg-s4e-bg-brand-subtle " +
      "focus-visible:ring-s4e-focus-ring",
  },
  destructive: {
    solid:
      "bg-s4e-btn-error-600 text-s4e-text-on-accent " +
      "hover:bg-s4e-btn-error-700 " +
      "focus-visible:ring-s4e-focus-ring-error",
    outline:
      "border border-s4e-text-error text-s4e-text-error bg-transparent " +
      "hover:bg-s4e-bg-error-subtle " +
      "focus-visible:ring-s4e-focus-ring-error",
    ghost:
      "text-s4e-text-error bg-transparent " +
      "hover:bg-s4e-bg-error-subtle " +
      "focus-visible:ring-s4e-focus-ring-error",
  },
};

const SPINNER_PX: Record<Size, number> = { sm: 13, md: 14, lg: 16 };

function Spinner({ size }: { size: number }) {
  return (
    <span
      aria-hidden
      className="inline-block rounded-full animate-spin border-2 border-current/30 border-t-current"
      style={{ width: size, height: size }}
    />
  );
}

export const Button = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(
  (
    {
      intent   = "primary",
      variant  = "solid",
      size     = "md",
      loading  = false,
      iconOnly = false,
      disabled,
      className,
      children,
      type,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    return (
      <button
        ref={ref}
        type={type ?? "button"}
        disabled={disabled || loading}
        className={cn(
          BASE,
          iconOnly ? ICON_ONLY_SIZE[size] : SIZE_CLASS[size],
          VARIANT_CLASS[intent][variant],
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {loading ? <Spinner size={SPINNER_PX[size]} /> : children}
      </button>
    );
  },
);
Button.displayName = "Button";
```

<!-- ===== Checkbox (checkbox) ===== -->

---
title: Checkbox
slug: checkbox
category: Atom
status: beta
source: components/ui/checkbox.tsx
styleguide: /styleguide/checkbox
figma: TBD
apg: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/checkbox/
---

# Checkbox

Lets the user turn an independent option on or off, or pick several items from a list.

## Overview

### When to use
- Several independent choices ("Notify by email", "Notify by Slack").
- Selecting rows in a table, including a "select all" header with an indeterminate state.
- A single opt-in that takes effect on submit ("I accept the terms").

### When not to use
- Mutually exclusive choices → [Radio](./switch-radio.md).
- A setting that applies **immediately** → [Switch](./switch-radio.md).

## Anatomy

```
┌──┐
│✓ │ ② Label
└──┘   ③ Description
 ①
```

1. **Box** (18px): empty, checked (✓) or indeterminate (–).
2. **Label**: clicking it toggles the box, because the whole row is a `<label>`.
3. **Description** (optional): secondary explanation.

## Variants

| Tone | Use for |
|---|---|
| `primary` *(default)* | Forms and settings |
| `neutral` | Dense data tables, where brand colour would be noisy |

## States

| State | Visual | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| Unchecked | Grey-400 border | — |
| Checked | Filled with tone colour + ✓ | — |
| Indeterminate | Filled + – | Some, but not all, children are selected |
| Hover | Border darkens | — |
| Focus | Brand ring on the box | Native input focus |
| Disabled | Muted label | Native `disabled` |

## Content guidelines
- Phrase the label positively ("Send weekly report", not "Don't send weekly report").
- No ending punctuation unless the label is a full sentence.

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Use indeterminate only for a parent of a group | Use indeterminate as a third "unknown" value |
| Make the label clickable (default) | Put a link inside the label that toggles the box when clicked |

## Accessibility

**Pattern:** [APG — Checkbox](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/checkbox/)

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `Tab` | Focus |
| `Space` | Toggle |

- Built on a visually hidden native `<input type="checkbox">`, so screen readers and forms work natively.
- The label is associated through `htmlFor` / `id`.
- `indeterminate` is set on the native input's DOM property, so screen readers announce "mixed".
- `description` is linked with `aria-describedby`. An `id` is generated when you don't pass one.

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Fill (primary / neutral) | `s4e-btn-primary-600` / `s4e-btn-neutral-800` |
| Empty border / bg | `s4e-neutral-grey-400` / `s4e-surface-row` |
| Check icon | `s4e-text-on-accent` |
| Label / description / disabled | `s4e-text-primary` / `s4e-text-secondary` / `s4e-text-disabled` |
| Focus ring | `s4e-focus-ring` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma property | Prop | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Checked | `checked` | true / false |
| Indeterminate | `indeterminate` | true / false |
| Tone | `tone` | Primary · Neutral |
| Disabled | `disabled` | true / false |

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `checked` | `boolean` | — | **Required**, controlled |
| `onChange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` | — | Toggle handler |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` | `false` | Mixed state |
| `tone` | `"primary" \| "neutral"` | `"primary"` | Fill colour |
| `label` | `string` | — | Visible label |
| `description` | `string` | — | Secondary text |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Native disabled |
| …rest | `InputHTMLAttributes` (minus `type`, `onChange`) | — | Forwarded to `<input>` |

## Examples

```tsx
<Checkbox checked={email} onChange={setEmail} label="Email" description="Daily digest at 09:00" />

<Checkbox
  aria-label="Select all rows"
  checked={allSelected}
  indeterminate={someSelected && !allSelected}
  onChange={toggleAll}
  tone="neutral"
/>
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] `checked` is required, so there's no uncontrolled mode.
- [ ] No checkbox-group wrapper with a `<fieldset>` + `<legend>`.

## Related
- [Switch · Radio](./switch-radio.md) · [Data Table](./data-table.md)

### Source — `components/ui/checkbox.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { Check, Minus } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — Checkbox
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/checkbox.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 *   • lucide-react for the Check / Minus icons.
 */

type Tone = "primary" | "neutral";

export interface CheckboxProps
  extends Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, "onChange" | "type"> {
  checked:        boolean;
  indeterminate?: boolean;
  onChange?:      (v: boolean) => void;
  tone?:          Tone;
  label?:         string;
  description?:   string;
}

const FILL_CLASS: Record<Tone, string> = {
  primary: "bg-s4e-btn-primary-600 border-s4e-btn-primary-600",
  neutral: "bg-s4e-btn-neutral-800 border-s4e-btn-neutral-800",
};

const EMPTY_CLASS = "border-s4e-neutral-grey-400 bg-s4e-surface-row";

export const Checkbox = React.forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, CheckboxProps>(
  (
    {
      checked,
      indeterminate = false,
      onChange,
      disabled = false,
      tone = "primary",
      label,
      description,
      id,
      className,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    const inputRef  = React.useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
    React.useImperativeHandle(ref, () => inputRef.current as HTMLInputElement);

    // `indeterminate` only exists as a DOM property — without this, screen
    // readers announce "not checked" instead of "mixed".
    React.useEffect(() => {
      if (inputRef.current) inputRef.current.indeterminate = indeterminate;
    }, [indeterminate]);

    const autoId    = React.useId();
    const inputId   = id ?? autoId;
    const descId    = `${inputId}-description`;
    const filled    = checked || indeterminate;
    const fillClass = filled ? FILL_CLASS[tone] : EMPTY_CLASS;

    return (
      <label
        htmlFor={inputId}
        className={cn(
          "flex items-start gap-2.5 group",
          disabled ? "cursor-not-allowed opacity-40" : "cursor-pointer",
          className,
        )}
      >
        <span className="relative inline-flex items-center justify-center mt-[1px]">
          <input
            ref={inputRef}
            id={inputId}
            type="checkbox"
            aria-describedby={description ? descId : undefined}
            checked={checked}
            disabled={disabled}
            onChange={(e) => onChange?.(e.target.checked)}
            className="peer sr-only"
            {...props}
          />
          <span
            aria-hidden
            className={cn(
              "w-[18px] h-[18px] rounded-[3px] border-2 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors",
              "peer-focus-visible:ring-2 peer-focus-visible:ring-offset-1 peer-focus-visible:ring-s4e-focus-ring",
              fillClass,
              !disabled && !filled && "group-hover:border-s4e-neutral-grey-600",
            )}
          >
            {indeterminate
              ? <Minus size={12} aria-hidden className="text-s4e-text-on-accent" />
              : checked && <Check size={12} aria-hidden className="text-s4e-text-on-accent" />
            }
          </span>
        </span>
        {(label || description) && (
          <span className="flex-1 min-w-0">
            {label && (
              <span className={cn(
                "block text-[14px] leading-tight",
                disabled ? "text-s4e-text-disabled" : "text-s4e-text-primary",
              )}>
                {label}
              </span>
            )}
            {description && (
              <span id={descId} className="block text-[11px] text-s4e-text-secondary mt-0.5 leading-snug">
                {description}
              </span>
            )}
          </span>
        )}
      </label>
    );
  },
);
Checkbox.displayName = "Checkbox";
```

<!-- ===== Select (select) ===== -->

---
title: Select
slug: select
category: Atom
status: beta
source: components/ui/select.tsx
styleguide: /styleguide/select
figma: TBD
apg: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox/examples/combobox-select-only/
---

# Select

A single-choice dropdown that picks one value from a list of options.

## Overview

### When to use
- One choice from 5–15 known options (severity, region, scan profile).

### When not to use
- 2–4 options that should all be visible → [Radio](./switch-radio.md).
- More than ~15 options, or the user needs to type to search → a searchable combobox (not built yet).
- Several selections → a checkbox list or multi-select (not built yet).
- Triggering actions (Edit, Delete) → a menu (not built yet), not a select.

## Anatomy

```
① Label
┌──────────────────────────┐
│ ② Selected value     ③ ▾ │  ← trigger (role="combobox")
└──────────────────────────┘
┌──────────────────────────┐
│ ④ Option             ⑤ ✓ │  ← listbox
│   Option (disabled)      │
└──────────────────────────┘
⑥ Helper / error text
```

1. **Label**: `<label>` tied to the trigger.
2. **Value / placeholder.**
3. **Chevron**: rotates when open.
4. **Option**: highlighted by keyboard or hover (`surface-row-hover`).
5. **Selected check.**
6. **Helper / error text.**

## States

| State | Visual | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| Default | Grey border | — |
| Hover | `neutral-grey-500` border | — |
| Focus | Brand border + `focus-visible` ring | — |
| Open | Brand border + soft ring, listbox below | Closes on outside click, Escape, Tab or selection |
| Error | Red border, label and helper | `aria-invalid` |
| Disabled | 40% opacity | Not focusable |
| Option disabled | `text-disabled` | Skipped by arrow keys and typeahead |

## Content guidelines
- Placeholder: "Select…" or a specific prompt ("Select severity"). It isn't a valid value.
- Order options logically: by severity, frequency or alphabet. Say which in the design.
- Keep option labels short. Long labels truncate.

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Pre-select a sensible default when one exists | Force a choice the user doesn't care about |
| Use Radio when there are ≤4 options | Hide 2 options behind a dropdown |

## Accessibility

**Pattern:** [APG — Select-only combobox](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox/examples/combobox-select-only/)

| Key | Closed | Open |
|---|---|---|
| `↓` / `↑` | Open, highlight the selected (or first) option | Move the highlight, skipping disabled options, wrapping around |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Open | Select the highlighted option and close |
| `Home` / `End` | — | First / last enabled option |
| `Escape` | — | Close without changing the value |
| `Tab` | Move focus | Close and move focus |
| Printable char | Open and jump to the first match | Typeahead (500ms buffer) |

- Focus stays on the trigger. The highlighted option is exposed with `aria-activedescendant`.
- The trigger has `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-labelledby` (label + value) and `aria-describedby` (helper).
- Options are `role="option"` with `aria-selected` / `aria-disabled`.

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Trigger / listbox bg | `s4e-surface-row` |
| Option hover / active | `s4e-surface-row-hover` |
| Selected option tint / check | `s4e-brand-primary-500` @ 8% / `s4e-brand-primary-500` |
| Border default / hover / focus / error | `s4e-border-strong` / `-500` / `s4e-border-focus` / `s4e-border-error` |
| Listbox border / shadow | `s4e-border-default` / `shadow-s4e-lg` |
| Value / placeholder / helper | `s4e-text-primary` / `s4e-text-secondary` / `s4e-text-secondary` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma property | Prop | Values |
|---|---|---|
| State | `state` | Default · Hover · Focused · Error · Disabled |
| Label / Helper | `label`, `helperText`, `errorText` | text |
| Placeholder | `placeholder` | text |

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `options` | `{ value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }[]` | — | **Required** |
| `value` | `string` | — | Controlled value |
| `onChange` | `(value: string) => void` | — | Called on selection |
| `label` | `string` | — | Visible label |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `"Select…"` | Shown when there's no value |
| `state` | `"default" \| "hover" \| "focused" \| "error" \| "disabled"` | `"default"` | Visual state. PascalCase values (`"Error"`) still work but are deprecated. |
| `helperText` / `errorText` | `string` | — | Messages |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the trigger |
| …rest | `HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Applied to the wrapper; `ref` → wrapper |

## Examples

```tsx
<Select
  label="Severity"
  placeholder="Select severity"
  value={severity}
  onChange={setSeverity}
  options={[
    { value: "critical", label: "Critical" },
    { value: "high", label: "High" },
    { value: "medium", label: "Medium" },
    { value: "low", label: "Low" },
  ]}
/>
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] The listbox is absolutely positioned. It can be clipped by `overflow: hidden` parents and doesn't flip near the viewport edge. Portal + collision handling (or `@base-ui/react` Select) needed.
- [ ] No `name` / hidden input, so it doesn't participate in native `<form>` submit.
- [ ] No option groups, icons or descriptions.

## Related
- [Radio](./switch-radio.md) · [Text Field](./text-field.md) · [Filter Bar](./filter-bar.md)

### Source — `components/ui/select.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { Check, ChevronDown } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — Select
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/select.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 *   • lucide-react for the Check / ChevronDown icons.
 */

export type SelectOption = {
  value:     string;
  label:     string;
  disabled?: boolean;
};

export type SelectState = "default" | "hover" | "focused" | "error" | "disabled";
/** @deprecated Use the lowercase values — every other component uses lowercase states. */
export type LegacySelectState = "Default" | "Hover" | "Focused" | "Error" | "Disabled";

export interface SelectProps
  extends Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "onChange"> {
  label?:       string;
  options:      SelectOption[];
  value?:       string;
  onChange?:    (v: string) => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  state?:       SelectState | LegacySelectState;
  helperText?:  string;
  errorText?:   string;
  disabled?:    boolean;
}

const BORDER_CLASS: Record<SelectState, string> = {
  default:  "border-s4e-border-strong",
  hover:    "border-s4e-neutral-grey-500",
  focused:  "border-s4e-border-focus",
  error:    "border-s4e-border-error",
  disabled: "border-s4e-border-strong",
};

export const Select = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, SelectProps>(
  (
    {
      label,
      options,
      value,
      onChange,
      placeholder = "Select…",
      state: stateProp = "default",
      helperText,
      errorText,
      disabled = false,
      className,
      id,
      ...props
    },
    forwardedRef,
  ) => {
    const [open, setOpen]            = React.useState(false);
    const [activeIndex, setActive]   = React.useState(-1);
    const innerRef                   = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const listRef                    = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const typeahead                  = React.useRef({ query: "", timer: 0 });
    React.useImperativeHandle(forwardedRef, () => innerRef.current as HTMLDivElement);

    const autoId    = React.useId();
    const baseId    = id ?? autoId;
    const labelId   = `${baseId}-label`;
    const triggerId = `${baseId}-trigger`;
    const listId    = `${baseId}-listbox`;
    const helperId  = `${baseId}-helper`;
    const optionId  = (i: number) => `${baseId}-option-${i}`;

    React.useEffect(() => {
      if (!open) return;
      const handler = (e: MouseEvent) => {
        if (innerRef.current && !innerRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
          setOpen(false);
        }
      };
      document.addEventListener("mousedown", handler);
      return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handler);
    }, [open]);

    // Keep the keyboard-highlighted option in view.
    React.useEffect(() => {
      if (!open || activeIndex < 0) return;
      const el = listRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`#${CSS.escape(optionId(activeIndex))}`);
      el?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    }, [open, activeIndex]);

    const state      = stateProp.toLowerCase() as SelectState;
    const isError    = state === "error";
    const isDisabled = disabled || state === "disabled";
    const isFocused  = state === "focused" || open;
    const selected   = options.find((o) => o.value === value);
    const message    = isError && errorText ? errorText : helperText;

    const enabledStep = (from: number, dir: 1 | -1) => {
      for (let i = 1; i <= options.length; i++) {
        const next = (from + dir * i + options.length) % options.length;
        if (!options[next].disabled) return next;
      }
      return from;
    };
    const firstEnabled = () => options.findIndex((o) => !o.disabled);
    const lastEnabled  = () => {
      for (let i = options.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (!options[i].disabled) return i;
      return -1;
    };

    const openMenu = (index?: number) => {
      const selectedIndex = options.findIndex((o) => o.value === value && !o.disabled);
      setActive(index ?? (selectedIndex >= 0 ? selectedIndex : firstEnabled()));
      setOpen(true);
    };

    const commit = (index: number) => {
      const opt = options[index];
      if (!opt || opt.disabled) return;
      onChange?.(opt.value);
      setOpen(false);
    };

    const onTypeahead = (char: string) => {
      const t = typeahead.current;
      window.clearTimeout(t.timer);
      t.query += char.toLowerCase();
      t.timer = window.setTimeout(() => { t.query = ""; }, 500);
      const start = open ? activeIndex : -1;
      for (let i = 1; i <= options.length; i++) {
        const idx = (start + i) % options.length;
        const opt = options[idx];
        if (!opt.disabled && opt.label.toLowerCase().startsWith(t.query)) {
          if (open) setActive(idx);
          else openMenu(idx);
          return;
        }
      }
    };

    const onKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
      if (isDisabled) return;
      switch (e.key) {
        case "ArrowDown":
          e.preventDefault();
          if (!open) openMenu();
          else setActive((i) => enabledStep(i, 1));
          break;
        case "ArrowUp":
          e.preventDefault();
          if (!open) openMenu();
          else setActive((i) => enabledStep(i, -1));
          break;
        case "Home":
          if (open) { e.preventDefault(); setActive(firstEnabled()); }
          break;
        case "End":
          if (open) { e.preventDefault(); setActive(lastEnabled()); }
          break;
        case "Enter":
        case " ":
          e.preventDefault();
          if (open) commit(activeIndex);
          else openMenu();
          break;
        case "Escape":
          if (open) { e.preventDefault(); setOpen(false); }
          break;
        case "Tab":
          setOpen(false);
          break;
        default:
          if (e.key.length === 1 && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.altKey) {
            onTypeahead(e.key);
          }
      }
    };

    const borderClass = isError
      ? BORDER_CLASS.error
      : isFocused
        ? BORDER_CLASS.focused
        : BORDER_CLASS[state];

    return (
      <div ref={innerRef} className={cn("w-full", className)} {...props}>
        {label && (
          <label
            id={labelId}
            htmlFor={triggerId}
            className={cn(
              "block text-[11px] font-medium mb-1.5",
              isError ? "text-s4e-text-error" : "text-s4e-text-secondary",
            )}
          >
            {label}
          </label>
        )}
        <div className="relative">
          <button
            id={triggerId}
            type="button"
            role="combobox"
            disabled={isDisabled}
            onClick={() => (open ? setOpen(false) : openMenu())}
            onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
            aria-haspopup="listbox"
            aria-expanded={open}
            aria-controls={open ? listId : undefined}
            aria-activedescendant={open && activeIndex >= 0 ? optionId(activeIndex) : undefined}
            aria-labelledby={label ? `${labelId} ${triggerId}` : undefined}
            aria-invalid={isError || undefined}
            aria-describedby={message ? helperId : undefined}
            className={cn(
              "w-full flex items-center justify-between gap-2 h-9 px-3 rounded-md text-[14px] text-left transition-colors",
              "border", borderClass, "bg-s4e-surface-row",
              isDisabled
                ? "opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed"
                : "cursor-pointer hover:border-s4e-neutral-grey-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-s4e-border-focus focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-s4e-focus-ring/40",
              isFocused && !isError && "ring-2 ring-s4e-focus-ring/20",
            )}
          >
            <span
              className={cn(
                selected ? "text-s4e-text-primary" : "text-s4e-text-secondary",
                "truncate",
              )}
            >
              {selected?.label ?? placeholder}
            </span>
            <ChevronDown
              size={14}
              aria-hidden
              className={cn(
                "shrink-0 text-s4e-text-secondary transition-transform",
                open && "rotate-180",
              )}
            />
          </button>

          {open && !isDisabled && (
            <div
              ref={listRef}
              id={listId}
              role="listbox"
              aria-labelledby={label ? labelId : undefined}
              className="absolute z-20 left-0 right-0 mt-1.5 max-h-60 overflow-auto rounded-md border border-s4e-border-default bg-s4e-surface-row shadow-s4e-lg"
            >
              {options.map((opt, i) => {
                const isSel    = opt.value === value;
                const isActive = i === activeIndex;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={opt.value}
                    id={optionId(i)}
                    role="option"
                    aria-selected={isSel}
                    aria-disabled={opt.disabled || undefined}
                    // Keep focus on the trigger so keyboard handling stays in one place.
                    onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                    onMouseEnter={() => !opt.disabled && setActive(i)}
                    onClick={() => commit(i)}
                    className={cn(
                      "w-full flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-[14px] text-left",
                      opt.disabled
                        ? "text-s4e-text-disabled cursor-not-allowed"
                        : "text-s4e-text-primary cursor-pointer",
                      isActive && !opt.disabled && "bg-s4e-surface-row-hover",
                      isSel && !isActive && "bg-s4e-brand-primary-500/8",
                    )}
                  >
                    <span className="truncate">{opt.label}</span>
                    {isSel && (
                      <Check size={14} aria-hidden className="text-s4e-brand-primary-500 shrink-0" />
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        {message && (
          <div
            id={helperId}
            className={cn(
              "mt-1 text-[11px] leading-tight",
              isError ? "text-s4e-text-error" : "text-s4e-text-secondary",
            )}
          >
            {message}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  },
);
Select.displayName = "Select";
```

<!-- ===== Severity Badge (severity-badge) ===== -->

---

slug: severity-badge
category: Atom

styleguide: /styleguide/severity-badge

# Severity Badge

The canonical way to show a finding's severity (Critical → Info), optionally with its numeric score (e.g. CVSS).

## Overview

### When to use
- Any time a vulnerability, threat or finding's severity is shown: tables, cards, detail headers.

### When not to use
- Generic statuses (Active, Failed) → [Badge](./badge-tag.md).
- Aggregate severity charts → [Chart](./chart.md), which uses the same `s4e-severity-*` palette.

## Anatomy

```
┌──────────────────────┐
│ ① High        ② 8.1  │
└──────────────────────┘
```

1. **Label**: fixed text per severity (always shown; colour is never the only signal).
2. **Score** (optional): right-aligned at 80% opacity.

Width is fixed at 160px (`w-40`) so columns align in tables.

## Variants

| `severity` | Colour family | Typical CVSS |
|---|---|---|
| `critical` | Purple | 9.0–10.0 |
| `high` | Red | 7.0–8.9 |
| `medium` | Yellow | 4.0–6.9 |
| `low` | Green | 0.1–3.9 |
| `info` | Blue | 0.0 |

The order and colours are product-wide conventions. Don't recolour them per screen.

## States
Static.

## Content guidelines
- Labels are fixed ("Critical", "High", …). Don't localise them ad hoc or abbreviate them ("Crit").
- Show the score with one decimal place.

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Sort tables by severity, then score | Sort severity alphabetically |
| Use the same badge in every surface | Recreate severity colours with a generic Badge |

## Accessibility
- The label text carries the meaning, so it passes WCAG 1.4.1 (use of colour).
- When the score is shown, give screen readers context: `aria-label="Severity high, score 8.1"` on the root, or visually hidden text.
- Contrast: `*-600` / `*-700` text on `*-50` passes 4.5:1.

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Background | `s4e-scale-{purple,red,yellow,green,blue}-50` |
| Accent | `s4e-scale-*-500` |
| Text | `s4e-scale-*-600` (yellow `-700`) |
| Data-viz equivalent | `--s4e-severity-{critical,high,medium,low,info}` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma property | Prop | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Severity | `severity` | Critical · High · Medium · Low · Info |
| Show score | `score` | number / unset |

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `severity` | `"critical" \| "high" \| "medium" \| "low" \| "info"` | — | **Required** |
| `score` | `number` | — | Optional numeric score |
| …rest | `HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Forwarded |

## Examples

```tsx
<SeverityBadge severity="critical" />
<SeverityBadge severity="high" score={8.1} aria-label="Severity high, score 8.1" />
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] The fixed `w-40` width doesn't adapt to narrow columns. Add a `size="sm"` / auto-width option.
- [ ] Uses primitive `scale-*` tokens. It should use the semantic `s4e-severity-*` tokens so chart and badge colours can't drift apart.
- [ ] No compact dot-only variant for dense lists (it would need hidden text).

## Related
- [Badge · Tag](./badge-tag.md) · [Data Table](./data-table.md) · [Chart](./chart.md)

### Source — `components/ui/severity-badge.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — SeverityBadge
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/severity-badge.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 */

type Severity = "low" | "critical" | "high" | "medium" | "info";

export interface SeverityBadgeProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  severity: Severity;
  score?:   number;
}

type SeverityConfig = {
  label:  string;
  bg:     string;
  accent: string;
  text:   string;
};

const SEVERITY: Record<Severity, SeverityConfig> = {
  low: {
    label:  "Low",
    bg:     "bg-s4e-scale-green-50",
    accent: "border-l-[3px] border-s4e-scale-green-500",
    text:   "text-s4e-scale-green-600",
  },
  critical: {
    label:  "Critical",
    bg:     "bg-s4e-scale-purple-50",
    accent: "border-l-[3px] border-s4e-scale-purple-500",
    text:   "text-s4e-scale-purple-600",
  },
  high: {
    label:  "High",
    bg:     "bg-s4e-scale-red-50",
    accent: "border-l-[3px] border-s4e-scale-red-500",
    text:   "text-s4e-scale-red-600",
  },
  medium: {
    label:  "Medium",
    bg:     "bg-s4e-scale-yellow-50",
    accent: "border-l-[3px] border-s4e-scale-yellow-500",
    text:   "text-s4e-scale-yellow-700",
  },
  info: {
    label:  "Info",
    bg:     "bg-s4e-scale-blue-50",
    accent: "border-l-[3px] border-s4e-scale-blue-500",
    text:   "text-s4e-scale-blue-600",
  },
};

const BASE = "flex items-center rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 w-40";

export const SeverityBadge = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, SeverityBadgeProps>(
  ({ severity, score, className, ...props }, ref) => {
    const cfg = SEVERITY[severity];
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          BASE,
          score !== undefined ? "justify-between" : "",
          cfg.bg,
          cfg.accent,
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <span className={cn("text-sm font-medium", cfg.text)}>{cfg.label}</span>
        {score !== undefined && (
          <span className={cn("text-sm font-normal opacity-80", cfg.text)}>{score}</span>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  },
);
SeverityBadge.displayName = "SeverityBadge";
```
