# Skeleton

A pulsing placeholder that mirrors the shape of content while it loads.

## Overview

### When to use
- Loading cards, tables, lists or charts whose layout is known.
- First load of a page section, to avoid layout shift (CLS).

### When not to use
- Short inline waits or unknown layouts → [Spinner](./spinner.md).
- Background refreshes of content that's already shown. Keep the stale content and show a subtle indicator instead.

## Anatomy
A single `<span class="block">` with the `s4e-pulse-dot` animation and `rounded-md`. Shape it with `className`:

| Shape | Recipe |
|---|---|
| Line | `h-3 w-48` |
| Block | `h-16 w-48` |
| Avatar | `h-10 w-10 rounded-full` |

## States
Single state. The pulse stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

## Content guidelines
- Match the real layout: same count of lines, similar widths, the last line shorter.
- Don't show a skeleton for more than ~10s. Switch to an error or empty state.

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Compose skeletons to match the final component | Use a single giant grey box for a whole page |
| Swap to real content in one step | Replace skeleton pieces one by one, which looks jittery |

## Accessibility
- Each skeleton is `aria-hidden`, so it's invisible to assistive tech.
- Announce loading on the container instead: `aria-busy="true"`, plus a visually hidden "Loading findings…" `role="status"` message.

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Fill | `s4e-neutral-grey-200` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma property | Code |
|---|---|
| Shape = Line / Block / Avatar | `className` recipes above |

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `className` | `string` | — | Size and shape |
| …rest | `HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>` | — | Forwarded; `ref` → `<span>` |

## Examples

```tsx
<div aria-busy="true" className="space-y-2">
  <span className="sr-only" role="status">Loading findings…</span>
  <Skeleton className="h-3 w-64" />
  <Skeleton className="h-3 w-56" />
  <Skeleton className="h-3 w-40" />
</div>
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] No preset shape props (`variant="line" | "block" | "circle"`). Designers' Figma variants have no 1:1 prop.
- [ ] No composed presets (SkeletonCard, SkeletonTableRow).

## Related
- [Spinner](./spinner.md) · [Data Table](./data-table.md) · [Cards](./cards.md)

### Source — `components/ui/skeleton.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — Skeleton
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/skeleton.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 *   • The `s4e-pulse-dot` keyframe utility from tokens.css.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   <Skeleton className="h-3 w-48" />            // line
 *   <Skeleton className="h-16 w-48" />           // block
 *   <Skeleton className="h-10 w-10 rounded-full" />  // avatar
 */

export const Skeleton = React.forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>>(
  ({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
    <span
      ref={ref}
      aria-hidden
      className={cn("block bg-s4e-neutral-grey-200 rounded-md s4e-pulse-dot", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  ),
);
Skeleton.displayName = "Skeleton";
```

<!-- ===== Spinner (spinner) ===== -->

---
title: Spinner
slug: spinner
category: Atom
status: alpha
source: components/ui/spinner.tsx
styleguide: /styleguide/spinner
figma: TBD
apg: N/A (role="status")
---

# Spinner

An indeterminate loading indicator for short waits when the shape of the result is unknown.

## Overview

### When to use
- Short waits (< ~3s) inside a button, a small panel, or an inline region.
- When the content's layout isn't known in advance.

### When not to use
- Loading a page or card whose layout is known → [Skeleton](./skeleton.md). It reduces perceived wait time and layout shift.
- Long operations with measurable progress → a progress bar (not built yet).
- Inside a Button → use `<Button loading>`, which renders its own spinner.

## Anatomy

A single ring with a transparent segment (`border-t-transparent`), rotating with `animate-spin`.

## Variants

| `tone` | Use on |
|---|---|
| `primary` *(default)* | Light surfaces |
| `neutral` | Dense / secondary areas |
| `white` | Solid brand or dark surfaces |

## Sizes

| Size | Diameter | Stroke | Use for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xs` | 12px | 2px | Inline with 12px text |
| `sm` | 16px | 2px | Inline with 14px text, table cells |
| `md` *(default)* | 24px | 2.5px | Cards, panels |
| `lg` | 36px | 3px | Empty regions, full-panel loading |

## States
Single state. When reduced motion is on, the global rule stops the rotation, so pair the spinner with visible text for long waits.

## Content guidelines
- Override the `label` with something specific: "Loading findings", not "Loading".
- If a wait exceeds ~3s, add visible text ("Still working… large scans can take a minute").

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Show one spinner per region | Put a spinner on every row |
| Delay showing it by ~300ms to avoid flicker | Flash a spinner for 50ms loads |

## Accessibility
- `role="status"` with `aria-label={label}`, so assistive tech announces "Loading" politely.
- Mark the region being loaded `aria-busy="true"` while the spinner is visible.
- `prefers-reduced-motion` is respected globally (`app/globals.css`).

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Ring (primary / neutral / white) | `s4e-brand-primary-500` / `s4e-text-disabled` / `s4e-text-white` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma property | Prop | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Size | `size` | XS · SM · MD · LG |
| Tone | `tone` | Primary · Neutral · White |

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` | Diameter |
| `tone` | `"primary" \| "neutral" \| "white"` | `"primary"` | Colour |
| `label` | `string` | `"Loading"` | Accessible name |
| …rest | `HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>` | — | Forwarded |

## Examples

```tsx
<div aria-busy={loading}>
  {loading ? <Spinner label="Loading findings" /> : <FindingsList />}
</div>
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] Alpha: the size scale (12 / 16 / 24 / 36) doesn't match Button's internal spinner (13 / 14 / 16). Unify them so Button can reuse `Spinner`.
- [ ] The `neutral` tone uses `text-disabled` (2.27:1). That's acceptable for a decorative ring, but it fails 3:1 for non-text UI if the spinner is the only indicator.
- [ ] No built-in delay prop.

## Related
- [Skeleton](./skeleton.md) · [Button](./button.md)

### Source — `components/ui/spinner.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — Spinner
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/spinner.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 */

type Size = "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg";
type Tone = "primary" | "neutral" | "white";

export interface SpinnerProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement> {
  size?:  Size;
  tone?:  Tone;
  label?: string;
}

const SIZE_CLASS: Record<Size, string> = {
  xs: "w-3 h-3 border-2",
  sm: "w-4 h-4 border-2",
  md: "w-6 h-6 border-[2.5px]",
  lg: "w-9 h-9 border-[3px]",
};

const TONE_CLASS: Record<Tone, string> = {
  primary: "border-s4e-brand-primary-500/25 border-t-s4e-brand-primary-500",
  neutral: "border-s4e-text-disabled/25 border-t-s4e-text-secondary",
  white:   "border-s4e-text-white/30 border-t-s4e-text-white",
};

export const Spinner = React.forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, SpinnerProps>(
  (
    {
      size  = "md",
      tone  = "primary",
      label = "Loading",
      className,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    return (
      <span
        ref={ref}
        role="status"
        aria-label={label}
        className={cn("inline-block align-middle", className)}
        {...props}
      >
        <span
          className={cn(
            "block rounded-full animate-spin",
            SIZE_CLASS[size],
            TONE_CLASS[tone],
          )}
        />
        <span className="sr-only">{label}</span>
      </span>
    );
  },
);
Spinner.displayName = "Spinner";
```

<!-- ===== Switch · Radio (switch-radio) ===== -->

---
title: Switch · Radio
slug: switch-radio
category: Atom
status: stable
source: components/ui/switch-radio.tsx
styleguide: /styleguide/switch-radio
figma: TBD
apg: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/switch/ · https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/radio/
---

# Switch · Radio

**Switch** turns a single setting on or off, effective immediately.
**Radio** picks exactly one option from a small, visible set.

## Overview

### When to use
- **Switch:** a setting that applies the moment it changes ("Continuous scanning").
- **Radio:** 2–5 mutually exclusive options that should all be visible for comparison.

### When not to use
- A choice that only takes effect after "Save" → [Checkbox](./checkbox.md), not a Switch.
- More than ~5 options → [Select](./select.md).
- Multiple selections → [Checkbox](./checkbox.md).

## Anatomy

```
Switch                      Radio group
┌────────●┐ ② Label         ◉ ② Option A
└─────────┘                 ○   Option B
 ① track + thumb            ① circle + dot
```

1. **Switch:** a 36×22 track with a 16px thumb. **Radio:** an 18px circle with an 8px dot.
2. **Label**: pass it as a sibling or child, and always associate it (see Accessibility).

## Variants

| Component | Variant | Use for |
|---|---|---|
| Switch | `dark` *(default)* | Neutral settings lists |
| Switch | `primary` | Brand-emphasised toggles (feature opt-ins) |

## States

| State | Switch | Radio |
|---|---|---|
| Off / unselected | Grey-300 track | Grey-400 border |
| On / selected | Dark or primary track, thumb slides right | Dark border + dot |
| Hover | Track darkens | Border darkens |
| Focus | `focus-visible` 2px brand ring | `focus-visible` 2px brand ring |
| Disabled | 40% opacity | 40% opacity, muted label |

## Content guidelines
- Switch label: describe the setting, not the action ("Email alerts", not "Turn on email alerts"). Don't write "On/Off" next to it; the switch already shows the state.
- Radio options: parallel grammar, similar length, ordered logically. Always pre-select one unless "none" is a valid answer.

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Apply a switch change immediately (optimistic UI + toast on failure) | Require "Save" after flipping a switch |
| Give a radio group a visible group label | Show orphan radios without context |

## Accessibility

**Patterns:** [APG Switch](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/switch/) · [APG Radio Group](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/radio/)

| Key | Switch | Radio group |
|---|---|---|
| `Tab` | Focus the switch | Focus the selected radio (one tab stop for the group) |
| `Space` / `Enter` | Toggle | Select the focused radio |
| `↓` `→` / `↑` `←` | — | Move to the next / previous radio **and** select it |

- Switch: `<button role="switch" aria-checked>`. Label it with `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby`, or a wrapping `<label>`.
- Radio: `role="radiogroup"` with `role="radio"` + `aria-checked`. Give the group `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby`.
- Roving tabindex: the checked radio (or the first one when nothing is checked) is the only Tab stop. Arrow keys wrap and skip disabled radios.

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Switch track off | `s4e-neutral-grey-300` |
| Switch track on (dark / primary) | `s4e-neutral-grey-900` / `s4e-btn-primary-600` (hover `-700`) |
| Radio border / dot | `s4e-neutral-grey-400` → `s4e-neutral-grey-800` |
| Label / disabled | `s4e-text-primary` / `s4e-text-disabled` |
| Focus ring | `s4e-focus-ring` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma property | Prop | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Switch / State | `checked` | On · Off |
| Switch / Variant | `variant` | Dark · Primary |
| Radio / Selected | `RadioGroup value` = `Radio value` | — |
| Disabled | `disabled` | true / false |

## API

**Switch**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `checked` | `boolean` | — | **Required**, controlled |
| `onChange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` | — | Toggle handler |
| `variant` | `"dark" \| "primary"` | `"dark"` | On colour |
| …rest | `ButtonHTMLAttributes` | — | Forwarded to `<button>` |

**RadioGroup**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string` | — | Selected value |
| `onChange` | `(value: string) => void` | — | Selection handler |
| `name` | `string` | — | Group name |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables all radios |

**Radio:** `value`, `checked?`, `onChange?`, …`ButtonHTMLAttributes`.

## Examples

```tsx
<label className="flex items-center gap-3">
  <Switch checked={continuous} onChange={setContinuous} />
  Continuous scanning
</label>

<RadioGroup aria-label="Scan depth" value={depth} onChange={setDepth}>
  <Radio value="light">Light</Radio>
  <Radio value="full">Full</Radio>
</RadioGroup>
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] The switch has no built-in `label` prop, so it's easy to ship unlabeled.
- [ ] The radio group has no `<fieldset>` / `<legend>` option, and `name` isn't used for native form submit.
- [ ] Thumb animation should respect reduced motion. The global rule now covers it.

## Related
- [Checkbox](./checkbox.md) · [Select](./select.md)

### Source — `components/ui/switch-radio.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — Switch & Radio
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/switch-radio.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 */

type SwitchVariant = "dark" | "primary";

export interface SwitchProps
  extends Omit<React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, "onChange"> {
  checked:   boolean;
  onChange?: (v: boolean) => void;
  variant?:  SwitchVariant;
}

const TRACK_ON: Record<SwitchVariant, string> = {
  dark:    "bg-s4e-neutral-grey-800",
  primary: "bg-s4e-btn-primary-600",
};

const TRACK_ON_HOVER: Record<SwitchVariant, string> = {
  dark:    "hover:bg-s4e-neutral-grey-900",
  primary: "hover:bg-s4e-btn-primary-700",
};

export const Switch = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, SwitchProps>(
  (
    {
      checked,
      onChange,
      variant = "dark",
      disabled = false,
      className,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    const track = checked
      ? cn(TRACK_ON[variant], !disabled && TRACK_ON_HOVER[variant])
      : cn("bg-s4e-neutral-grey-300", !disabled && "hover:bg-s4e-neutral-grey-400");

    return (
      <button
        ref={ref}
        type="button"
        role="switch"
        aria-checked={checked}
        disabled={disabled}
        onClick={() => onChange?.(!checked)}
        className={cn(
          "relative w-9 h-[22px] rounded-full transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-1 focus-visible:ring-s4e-focus-ring",
          track,
          disabled ? "opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed" : "cursor-pointer",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <span
          className={cn(
            "absolute top-[3px] w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow-sm transition-transform duration-200 ease-in-out",
            checked ? "translate-x-[18px]" : "translate-x-[3px]",
          )}
        />
      </button>
    );
  },
);
Switch.displayName = "Switch";

// ── Radio ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface RadioGroupContextValue {
  value?:    string;
  onChange?: (v: string) => void;
  name?:     string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

const RadioGroupContext = React.createContext<RadioGroupContextValue | null>(null);

export interface RadioGroupProps
  extends Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "onChange"> {
  value?:    string;
  onChange?: (v: string) => void;
  name?:     string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export const RadioGroup = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, RadioGroupProps>(
  ({ value, onChange, name, disabled, className, children, onKeyDown, ...props }, ref) => {
    const groupRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    React.useImperativeHandle(ref, () => groupRef.current as HTMLDivElement);

    const radios = () =>
      Array.from(
        groupRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('[role="radio"]:not([disabled])') ?? [],
      );

    // Roving tabindex: the checked radio (or the first one when nothing is
    // checked) is the group's single Tab stop.
    React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
      const all = radios();
      if (all.length && !all.some((r) => r.tabIndex === 0)) all[0].tabIndex = 0;
    }, [value]);

    // Arrow keys move focus and selection together (APG Radio Group).
    const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
      onKeyDown?.(e);
      if (e.defaultPrevented) return;
      const all = radios();
      const index = all.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLButtonElement);
      if (index < 0) return;
      let next: number | null = null;
      if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "ArrowRight") next = (index + 1) % all.length;
      if (e.key === "ArrowUp"   || e.key === "ArrowLeft")  next = (index - 1 + all.length) % all.length;
      if (next === null) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      all[next].focus();
      all[next].click();
    };

    return (
      <RadioGroupContext.Provider value={{ value, onChange, name, disabled }}>
        <div
          ref={groupRef}
          role="radiogroup"
          aria-disabled={disabled || undefined}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          className={cn("flex flex-wrap gap-x-6 gap-y-3", className)}
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </div>
      </RadioGroupContext.Provider>
    );
  },
);
RadioGroup.displayName = "RadioGroup";

export interface RadioProps
  extends Omit<React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, "onChange" | "value"> {
  value?:    string;
  checked?:  boolean;
  onChange?: () => void;
}

export const Radio = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, RadioProps>(
  (
    {
      value,
      checked: checkedProp,
      onChange,
      disabled: disabledProp,
      className,
      children,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    const group     = React.useContext(RadioGroupContext);
    const inGroup   = group !== null && value !== undefined;
    const checked   = inGroup ? group!.value === value : !!checkedProp;
    const disabled  = disabledProp ?? group?.disabled ?? false;
    const handleClick = () => {
      if (disabled) return;
      if (inGroup) group!.onChange?.(value!);
      else onChange?.();
    };

    const control = (
      <button
        ref={ref}
        type="button"
        role="radio"
        aria-checked={checked}
        tabIndex={inGroup ? (checked ? 0 : -1) : undefined}
        disabled={disabled}
        onClick={handleClick}
        className={cn(
          "w-[18px] h-[18px] rounded-full border-2 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-1 focus-visible:ring-s4e-focus-ring",
          checked
            ? "border-s4e-neutral-grey-800"
            : "border-s4e-neutral-grey-400 hover:border-s4e-neutral-grey-600",
          disabled ? "opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed" : "cursor-pointer",
          !children && className,
        )}
        {...(!children ? props : {})}
      >
        {checked && (
          <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-s4e-neutral-grey-800 transition-transform scale-100" />
        )}
      </button>
    );

    if (!children) return control;

    return (
      <label
        className={cn(
          "flex items-center gap-2.5 group",
          disabled ? "cursor-not-allowed" : "cursor-pointer",
          className,
        )}
      >
        {control}
        <span
          className={cn(
            "text-[14px]",
            disabled ? "text-s4e-text-disabled" : "text-s4e-text-primary",
          )}
        >
          {children}
        </span>
      </label>
    );
  },
);
Radio.displayName = "Radio";
```

<!-- ===== Text Field (text-field) ===== -->

---
title: Text Field
slug: text-field

# Text Field

A single-line input for short free text: names, domains, IPs, emails.

## Overview

### When to use
- The answer is one line and can't be picked from a known list.

### When not to use
- Multi-line text → [Textarea](./textarea.md).
- A choice from a known list → [Select](./select.md) (5+ options) or [Radio](./switch-radio.md) (2–5 options).
- Searching or filtering a list → [Search Bar](./search-bar.md).

## Anatomy

```
 filled                         outlined
┌─────────────────────┐        ┌─ ① Label ───────────┐
│ ① Label             │        │ ② Value             │
│ ② Value             │        └─────────────────────┘
└━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┘ ③       ④ Helper / error text
 ④ Helper / error text
```

1. **Label** (required for a11y): a real `<label>` tied to the input. In `outlined` it floats onto the border when the field is focused or filled.
2. **Input value / placeholder.**
3. **Indicator**: a bottom border (filled) or full border (outlined). It turns brand colour on focus and red on error.
4. **Helper / error text** (optional): read out together with the field via `aria-describedby`.

## Variants

| Variant | Use for |
|---|---|
| `filled` *(default)* | Dense forms and settings panels where fields sit on a white surface |
| `outlined` | Standalone fields, auth screens, fields on a tinted background |

Don't mix variants within a single form.

## States

| State | Visual | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| Default | Grey border, secondary-colour label | — |
| Focus | Brand-600 border (2px outlined), label turns brand | Driven by real focus. `state="focused"` only forces the look (docs, screenshots). |
| Filled | Label stays floated (outlined) | Tracked for both controlled and uncontrolled use |
| Error | Red border and label, red helper text | `aria-invalid="true"`; the error text replaces the helper text |
| Disabled | 40% opacity | Native `disabled` |

## Content guidelines
- Label: a short noun phrase in sentence case, no colon ("Target domain").
- Placeholder: an example format only ("example.com"). Never put the label or instructions in the placeholder.
- Error text: say what is wrong and how to fix it ("Enter a domain without https://"), not "Invalid input".
- Mark optional fields "(optional)" rather than marking required ones with `*`, unless most fields are optional.

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Always pass `label` (or `aria-label` if there's truly no visible label) | Use the placeholder as the label |
| Validate on blur or submit, then show `errorText` | Show an error while the user is still typing the first time |
| Use `type="email"`, `inputMode`, `autoComplete` | Force the generic keyboard on mobile |

## Accessibility

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `Tab` | Focus the input |
| Typing / standard editing keys | Native |

- `<label htmlFor>` is wired automatically through `useId`. A custom `id` you pass is respected.
- Helper and error text are linked with `aria-describedby`; errors set `aria-invalid`.
- Focus is visible: a 2px brand border plus the label colour change.
- Contrast: label, helper and placeholder use `text-secondary` (5.07:1 on white).

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Filled background | `s4e-bg-subtle` · error `s4e-bg-error-subtle` |
| Border default / focus / error / disabled | `s4e-border-strong` / `s4e-border-focus` / `s4e-border-error` / `s4e-neutral-grey-200` |
| Label | `s4e-text-secondary` · focus `s4e-brand-primary-600` · error `s4e-text-error` |
| Value | `s4e-text-primary` |
| Placeholder / helper | `s4e-text-secondary` |
| Floating label backdrop | `s4e-surface-app` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma property | Prop | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Variant | `variant` | Filled · Outlined |
| State | `state` / `disabled` | Default · Focused · Error · Disabled |
| Label | `label` | text |
| Helper | `helperText` / `errorText` | text |

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | — | Visible label, associated with the input |
| `variant` | `"filled" \| "outlined"` | `"filled"` | Visual style |
| `state` | `"default" \| "focused" \| "error" \| "disabled"` | `"default"` | Forces a visual state. `error` also sets `aria-invalid`. |
| `helperText` | `string` | — | Hint below the field |
| `errorText` | `string` | — | Shown when `state="error"` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | — | Native disabled |
| …rest | `InputHTMLAttributes` (minus `size`) | — | Forwarded to `<input>`; `ref` forwarded |

## Examples

```tsx
<TextField label="Target domain" placeholder="example.com" helperText="Without https://" />

<TextField
  variant="outlined"
  label="Email"
  type="email"
  autoComplete="email"
  value={email}
  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
  state={emailError ? "error" : "default"}
  errorText={emailError}
/>
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] The `state` prop mixes "visual override" with "validation". Consider a separate `invalid` boolean and keep `state` docs-only.
- [ ] No leading / trailing adornment slots (icon, unit, clear button).
- [ ] No `required` indicator convention.
- [ ] Hard-coded 11px / 14px font sizes. Move to typography tokens.

## Related
- [Textarea](./textarea.md) · [Select](./select.md) · [Search Bar](./search-bar.md)

### Source — `components/ui/text-field.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — TextField
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/text-field.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 */

type Variant = "filled" | "outlined";
type State   = "default" | "focused" | "error" | "disabled";

export interface TextFieldProps
  extends Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, "size"> {
  label?:      string;
  variant?:    Variant;
  state?:      State;
  helperText?: string;
  errorText?:  string;
}

const LABEL_COLOR: Record<State, string> = {
  default:  "text-s4e-text-secondary",
  focused:  "text-s4e-brand-primary-600",
  error:    "text-s4e-text-error",
  disabled: "text-s4e-text-disabled",
};

const FILLED_STYLE: Record<State, string> = {
  default:  "bg-s4e-bg-subtle border-b-2 border-s4e-border-strong",
  focused:  "bg-s4e-bg-subtle border-b-2 border-s4e-border-focus",
  error:    "bg-s4e-bg-error-subtle border-b-2 border-s4e-border-error",
  disabled: "bg-s4e-bg-subtle border-b-2 border-s4e-neutral-grey-200 opacity-40",
};

const OUTLINED_STYLE: Record<State, string> = {
  default:  "border border-s4e-border-strong",
  focused:  "border-2 border-s4e-border-focus",
  error:    "border border-s4e-border-error",
  disabled: "border border-s4e-neutral-grey-200 opacity-40",
};

export const TextField = React.forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, TextFieldProps>(
  (
    {
      label,
      variant    = "filled",
      state      = "default",
      helperText,
      errorText,
      disabled,
      className,
      value,
      defaultValue,
      id,
      onFocus,
      onBlur,
      onChange,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    const autoId   = React.useId();
    const inputId  = id ?? autoId;
    const helperId = `${inputId}-helper`;

    // Real focus + uncontrolled value are tracked internally so the label,
    // border and floating behaviour react to the keyboard — the `state` prop
    // only forces a visual state (e.g. for docs / screenshots).
    const [hasFocus, setHasFocus]   = React.useState(false);
    const [innerFilled, setFilled]  = React.useState(
      defaultValue !== undefined && defaultValue !== "",
    );

    const forcedState: State = disabled ? "disabled" : state;
    const resolvedState: State =
      forcedState === "default" && hasFocus ? "focused" : forcedState;
    const isError    = resolvedState === "error";
    const isFocused  = resolvedState === "focused" || (hasFocus && !isError);
    const isDisabled = resolvedState === "disabled";
    const hasValue   = value !== undefined ? value !== "" : innerFilled;
    const isActive   = hasValue || isFocused;

    const message    = isError && errorText ? errorText : helperText;

    const inputProps: React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> = {
      id:                 inputId,
      disabled:           isDisabled,
      value,
      defaultValue,
      "aria-invalid":     isError || undefined,
      "aria-describedby": message ? helperId : undefined,
      onFocus: (e) => { setHasFocus(true);  onFocus?.(e); },
      onBlur:  (e) => { setHasFocus(false); onBlur?.(e); },
      onChange: (e) => { setFilled(e.target.value !== ""); onChange?.(e); },
      className:
        "block w-full bg-transparent border-0 p-0 text-[14px] text-s4e-text-primary placeholder:text-s4e-text-secondary focus:outline-none disabled:cursor-not-allowed",
      ...props,
    };

    const helper = (
      <div className="mt-1 min-h-[14px]">
        {message ? (
          <span
            id={helperId}
            className={cn(
              "text-[11px]",
              variant === "filled" && "px-3",
              isError && errorText ? "text-s4e-text-error" : "text-s4e-text-secondary",
            )}
          >
            {message}
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    );

    if (variant === "filled") {
      return (
        <div className={cn("w-full", className)}>
          <div className={cn("rounded-t-md px-3 py-1.5", FILLED_STYLE[resolvedState])}>
            {label && (
              <label
                htmlFor={inputId}
                className={cn("block text-[11px] font-medium leading-none mb-1", LABEL_COLOR[resolvedState])}
              >
                {label}
              </label>
            )}
            <input ref={ref} {...inputProps} />
          </div>
          {helper}
        </div>
      );
    }

    return (
      <div className={cn("w-full", className)}>
        <div className={cn("relative rounded-md px-3 pt-3 pb-1.5", OUTLINED_STYLE[resolvedState])}>
          {label && (
            <label
              htmlFor={inputId}
              className={cn(
                "absolute text-[11px] font-medium leading-none pointer-events-none transition-all",
                isActive
                  ? cn("-top-[6px] left-2 bg-s4e-surface-app px-1", LABEL_COLOR[resolvedState])
                  : "top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 left-3 text-s4e-text-secondary",
              )}
            >
              {label}
            </label>
          )}
          <input ref={ref} {...inputProps} />
        </div>
        {helper}
      </div>
    );
  },
);
TextField.displayName = "TextField";
```

<!-- ===== Textarea (textarea) ===== -->

---
title: Textarea
slug: textarea
category: Atom
status: stable
source: components/ui/textarea.tsx
styleguide: /styleguide/textarea
figma: TBD
apg: N/A (native <textarea>)
---

# Textarea

A multi-line plain-text input for notes, descriptions and justifications.

## Overview

### When to use
- The answer may need more than one sentence (scan notes, exception justification).

### When not to use
- One-line answers → [Text Field](./text-field.md).
- Formatted text (bold, lists) → [Text Space](./text-space.md).

## Anatomy

```
① Label
┌──────────────────────────────┐
│ ② Value…                     │
│                           ③ ◢│
└──────────────────────────────┘
④ Helper / error text   ⑤ 12/200
```

1. **Label**: a `<label>` tied to the field.
2. **Value / placeholder.**
3. **Resize handle**: vertical only.
4. **Helper / error text**: linked through `aria-describedby`.
5. **Counter** (optional): shown when `showCounter` or `maxLength` is set. It turns warning colour above 90%.

## States

| State | Visual | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| Default | Grey border | — |
| Focus | Brand-600 border + 2px brand/20 ring | Real `:focus` styles; `state="focused"` forces them |
| Error | Red border, red helper | `aria-invalid="true"` |
| Near limit | Counter turns `scale-yellow-700` | At more than 90% of `maxLength` |
| Disabled | 40% opacity | Native `disabled` |

## Content guidelines
- Use the helper text to set the expected length ("2–3 sentences on why this is a false positive").
- With `maxLength`, the counter is the hint, so don't repeat "max 200 characters" in the helper.

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Size `rows` to the expected answer (default 4) | Use a 1-row textarea as a text field |
| Use `maxLength` when the back end enforces one | Silently truncate on submit |

## Accessibility

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `Tab` | Focus the field (Tab doesn't insert a tab character) |
| `Enter` | New line |

- Label, `aria-describedby` and `aria-invalid` are wired automatically.
- The counter is visual only. If the limit matters, mention it in the helper text so screen-reader users hear it too.

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Background | `s4e-surface-row` |
| Border default / focus / error / disabled | `s4e-border-strong` / `s4e-border-focus` / `s4e-border-error` / `s4e-neutral-grey-200` |
| Focus ring | `s4e-focus-ring` @ 20% |
| Text / placeholder / helper | `s4e-text-primary` / `s4e-text-secondary` / `s4e-text-secondary` |
| Counter warning | `s4e-scale-yellow-700` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma property | Prop | Values |
|---|---|---|
| State | `state` / `disabled` | Default · Focused · Error · Disabled |
| Counter | `showCounter` / `maxLength` | on / off, number |

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | — | Visible label |
| `state` | `"default" \| "focused" \| "error" \| "disabled"` | `"default"` | Visual state / validation |
| `helperText` | `string` | — | Hint |
| `errorText` | `string` | — | Shown when `state="error"` |
| `showCounter` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the length counter |
| `maxLength` | `number` | — | Native limit; also shows the counter |
| `rows` | `number` | `4` | Initial height |
| …rest | `TextareaHTMLAttributes` | — | Forwarded; `ref` forwarded |

## Examples

```tsx
<Textarea
  label="Justification"
  helperText="Why is this finding a false positive?"
  maxLength={280}
  value={note}
  onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}
/>
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] The counter only counts controlled `value`. It shows 0 when uncontrolled.
- [ ] No auto-grow option.
- [ ] Counter changes aren't announced. Consider a polite live region near the limit.

## Related
- [Text Field](./text-field.md) · [Text Space](./text-space.md)

### Source — `components/ui/textarea.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — Textarea
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/textarea.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 */

type State = "default" | "focused" | "error" | "disabled";

export interface TextareaProps
  extends Omit<React.TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement>, "state"> {
  label?:       string;
  state?:       State;
  helperText?:  string;
  errorText?:   string;
  showCounter?: boolean;
}

const STATE_BORDER: Record<State, string> = {
  default:  "border-s4e-border-strong",
  focused:  "border-s4e-border-focus ring-2 ring-s4e-focus-ring/20",
  error:    "border-s4e-border-error",
  disabled: "border-s4e-neutral-grey-200 opacity-40",
};

export const Textarea = React.forwardRef<HTMLTextAreaElement, TextareaProps>(
  (
    {
      label,
      state = "default",
      helperText,
      errorText,
      showCounter = false,
      maxLength,
      rows = 4,
      disabled,
      value,
      className,
      id,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    const autoId     = React.useId();
    const fieldId    = id ?? autoId;
    const helperId   = `${fieldId}-helper`;
    const resolvedState: State = disabled ? "disabled" : state;
    const isError    = resolvedState === "error";
    const isDisabled = resolvedState === "disabled";
    const len        = typeof value === "string" ? value.length : 0;
    const message    = isError && errorText ? errorText : helperText;

    return (
      <div className={cn("w-full", className)}>
        {label && (
          <label
            htmlFor={fieldId}
            className={cn(
              "block text-[11px] font-medium mb-1.5",
              isError ? "text-s4e-text-error" : "text-s4e-text-secondary",
            )}
          >
            {label}
          </label>
        )}
        <textarea
          ref={ref}
          id={fieldId}
          rows={rows}
          value={value}
          disabled={isDisabled}
          maxLength={maxLength}
          aria-invalid={isError || undefined}
          aria-describedby={message ? helperId : undefined}
          className={cn(
            "block w-full rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-[14px] text-s4e-text-primary placeholder:text-s4e-text-secondary bg-s4e-surface-row",
            "border resize-y transition-colors",
            "focus:outline-none focus:border-s4e-border-focus focus:ring-2 focus:ring-s4e-focus-ring/20",
            STATE_BORDER[resolvedState],
            isDisabled && "cursor-not-allowed",
          )}
          {...props}
        />
        <div className="mt-1 flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
          <div
            id={message ? helperId : undefined}
            className={cn(
              "text-[11px] leading-tight flex-1",
              isError ? "text-s4e-text-error" : "text-s4e-text-secondary",
            )}
          >
            {message}
          </div>
          {(showCounter || maxLength) && (
            <div
              className={cn(
                "text-[11px] tabular-nums shrink-0",
                maxLength && len > maxLength * 0.9
                  ? "text-s4e-scale-yellow-700"
                  : "text-s4e-text-secondary",
              )}
            >
              {len}{maxLength ? `/${maxLength}` : ""}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  },
);
Textarea.displayName = "Textarea";
```

<!-- ===== Toast · Tooltip (toast-tooltip) ===== -->

---
title: Toast · Tooltip
slug: toast-tooltip
category: Atom
status: stable
source: components/ui/toast-tooltip.tsx
styleguide: /styleguide/toast-tooltip
figma: TBD
apg: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/tooltip/ · https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/alert/
---

# Toast · Tooltip

**Toast** is a brief, non-blocking confirmation of something that just happened.
**Tooltip** is a short label or hint that appears on hover or focus of a control.

## Overview

### When to use
- **Toast:** confirming the result of a user action ("Scan started", "Report exported").
- **Tooltip:** naming an icon-only button, or giving a one-line definition of a term.

### When not to use
- Errors that block progress, or anything the user must act on → [Alert](./alert.md) or [Modal](./modal.md). Toasts disappear.
- System-wide announcements → [Banner](./banner.md) / [Alert](./alert.md).
- Essential information, or interactive content (links, buttons) → not a tooltip. Use inline text or a popover.
- Disabled controls → tooltips can't be reached on disabled elements (Atlassian guidance).

## Anatomy

```
Toast                                   Tooltip
┃ ① ✓  ② Title                 ④ ✕       ┌─────────────────┐
┃      ③ Description                     │ ① Content       │
└ intent bar                             └────────▼────────┘ ② arrow
```

Toast: ① intent icon · ② title · ③ description · ④ dismiss button, with a coloured left bar.
Tooltip: ① content (max width 224px) · ② arrow toward the trigger.

## Variants

| Toast `intent` | Use for |
|---|---|
| `success` | Action completed |
| `info` *(default)* | Neutral status ("Export is being prepared") |
| `warning` | Completed with caveats |
| `alert` | Action failed but can be retried |

| Tooltip `position` | `top` *(default)* · `bottom` · `left` · `right` |
|---|---|

## States

| Component | State | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| Toast | Visible | Should auto-dismiss after 5–8s, pause on hover / focus, and always be dismissible |
| Tooltip | Hidden → visible | Shows on hover (after `delay`, 300ms) and immediately on keyboard focus. Hides on `Escape`, blur or mouse leave. `open` forces it visible for docs. |

## Content guidelines
- Toast title: past tense, ≤ 6 words ("Scan scheduled"). The description is optional and one sentence.
- Tooltip: ≤ 1 short sentence, no ending period for fragments. Never repeat the visible label.

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Show one toast at a time and stack the rest | Use a toast for errors that need a fix |
| Use a tooltip to name icon-only buttons | Put links or buttons inside a tooltip |

## Accessibility

**Patterns:** [APG Tooltip](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/tooltip/) · [APG Alert](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/alert/)

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `Tab` to trigger | Tooltip appears |
| `Escape` | Tooltip hides (WCAG 1.4.13 "dismissible") |

- Toast: `role="status"` + `aria-live="polite"` for success / info / warning; `role="alert"` + `aria-live="assertive"` for `alert`. `aria-atomic` reads it as one message. For reliable announcements, render toasts into a viewport that's already mounted.
- Tooltip bubble: `role="tooltip"` with an `id`. A single element child automatically gets `aria-describedby` pointing to it.
- Toast dismiss button has `aria-label="Dismiss"`.

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Toast surface / border | `s4e-surface-app` / `s4e-border-default` |
| Toast intent bar + icon | `s4e-feedback-success` · `-info` · `-warning` · `-alert` |
| Toast title / description | `s4e-text-primary` / `s4e-text-secondary` |
| Tooltip bg / text | `s4e-neutral-grey-900` / `s4e-text-inverse` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma property | Prop | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Toast / Intent | `intent` | Success · Info · Warning · Alert |
| Tooltip / Position | `position` | Top · Bottom · Left · Right |

## API

**Toast**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `intent` | `"success" \| "alert" \| "info" \| "warning"` | `"info"` | Colour + icon |
| `title` | `string` | — | Heading |
| `description` | `string` | — | Body |
| `onDismiss` | `() => void` | — | Shows the ✕ button when set |

**Tooltip**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` | `string` | — | **Required** text |
| `position` | `"top" \| "bottom" \| "left" \| "right"` | `"top"` | Placement |
| `open` | `boolean` | — | Forces visibility (docs / screenshots) |
| `delay` | `number` | `300` | Hover delay in ms |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | The trigger |

## Examples

```tsx
<Toast intent="success" title="Scan scheduled" description="Runs daily at 02:00" onDismiss={close} />

<Tooltip content="Re-run scan">
  <Button iconOnly variant="ghost" intent="default" aria-label="Re-run scan"><RotateCw size={16} aria-hidden /></Button>
</Tooltip>
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] No toast manager (queue, auto-dismiss timer, pause on hover, portal / viewport placement).
- [ ] Intent colours look swapped: `alert` uses `feedback-warning` and `warning` uses `feedback-alert`. Confirm with design and fix.
- [ ] The tooltip doesn't flip or collide with the viewport.

## Related
- [Alert](./alert.md) · [Banner](./banner.md) · [Button](./button.md)

### Source — `components/ui/toast-tooltip.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { CircleCheck, CircleAlert, Lightbulb, Ban, X } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — Toast & Tooltip
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/toast-tooltip.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • lucide-react icons
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 */

// ── Toast ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type ToastIntent = "success" | "alert" | "info" | "warning";

export interface ToastProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  intent?:      ToastIntent;
  title?:       string;
  description?: string;
  onDismiss?:   () => void;
}

const TOAST_ICON: Record<ToastIntent, React.ComponentType<{ size?: number; className?: string }>> = {
  success: CircleCheck,
  alert:   CircleAlert,
  info:    Lightbulb,
  warning: Ban,
};

const TOAST_COLOR: Record<ToastIntent, string> = {
  success: "text-s4e-feedback-success",
  alert:   "text-s4e-feedback-warning",
  info:    "text-s4e-feedback-info",
  warning: "text-s4e-feedback-alert",
};

const TOAST_BAR: Record<ToastIntent, string> = {
  success: "bg-s4e-feedback-success",
  alert:   "bg-s4e-feedback-warning",
  info:    "bg-s4e-feedback-info",
  warning: "bg-s4e-feedback-alert",
};

export const Toast = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ToastProps>(
  (
    {
      intent = "info",
      title,
      description,
      onDismiss,
      className,
      children,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    const Icon = TOAST_ICON[intent];

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        // Failures interrupt; everything else is announced politely.
        role={intent === "alert" ? "alert" : "status"}
        aria-live={intent === "alert" ? "assertive" : "polite"}
        aria-atomic="true"
        className={cn(
          "overflow-hidden bg-s4e-surface-app border border-s4e-border-default rounded-xl shadow-sm",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3">
          <Icon size={20} aria-hidden className={cn("shrink-0", TOAST_COLOR[intent])} />
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
            {title && (
              <div className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-s4e-text-primary">{title}</div>
            )}
            {description && (
              <div className="text-[12px] text-s4e-text-secondary">{description}</div>
            )}
            {!title && !description && children}
          </div>
          {onDismiss && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onDismiss}
              className="shrink-0 rounded text-s4e-text-secondary hover:text-s4e-text-primary transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-s4e-focus-ring"
              aria-label="Dismiss"
            >
              <X size={15} aria-hidden />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="h-[3px] w-full bg-s4e-bg-subtle">
          <div className={cn("h-full toast-timer-bar", TOAST_BAR[intent])} />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  },
);
Toast.displayName = "Toast";

// ── Tooltip ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type TooltipPosition = "top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right";

export interface TooltipProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  content:    string;
  position?:  TooltipPosition;
  /** Force the bubble open (docs / screenshots). Omit for hover + focus behaviour. */
  open?:      boolean;
  /** Hover delay in ms before showing. */
  delay?:     number;
}

const BUBBLE_POS: Record<TooltipPosition, string> = {
  top:    "bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mb-2",
  bottom: "top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mt-2",
  left:   "right-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 mr-2",
  right:  "left-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 ml-2",
};

const ARROW_POS: Record<TooltipPosition, string> = {
  top:    "top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2",
  bottom: "bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2",
  left:   "left-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2",
  right:  "right-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2",
};

const ARROW_BORDER: Record<TooltipPosition, string> = {
  top:    "border-t-s4e-neutral-grey-900 border-b-transparent border-x-transparent",
  bottom: "border-b-s4e-neutral-grey-900 border-t-transparent border-x-transparent",
  left:   "border-l-s4e-neutral-grey-900 border-r-transparent border-y-transparent",
  right:  "border-r-s4e-neutral-grey-900 border-l-transparent border-y-transparent",
};

export const Tooltip = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, TooltipProps>(
  (
    {
      content,
      position = "top",
      open: forcedOpen,
      delay = 300,
      className,
      children,
      onMouseEnter,
      onMouseLeave,
      onFocus,
      onBlur,
      onKeyDown,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    const tooltipId          = React.useId();
    const [shown, setShown]  = React.useState(false);
    const timer              = React.useRef<number>(0);
    const open               = forcedOpen ?? shown;

    const show = (immediate = false) => {
      window.clearTimeout(timer.current);
      if (immediate) setShown(true);
      else timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setShown(true), delay);
    };
    const hide = () => {
      window.clearTimeout(timer.current);
      setShown(false);
    };
    React.useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), []);

    // Describe the trigger by the tooltip. A single element child gets
    // aria-describedby merged in; anything else relies on the wrapper.
    const trigger = React.isValidElement<{ "aria-describedby"?: string }>(children)
      ? React.cloneElement(children, {
          "aria-describedby": cn(children.props["aria-describedby"], tooltipId) || undefined,
        })
      : children;

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn("relative inline-flex", className)}
        onMouseEnter={(e) => { show(); onMouseEnter?.(e); }}
        onMouseLeave={(e) => { hide(); onMouseLeave?.(e); }}
        onFocus={(e) => { show(true); onFocus?.(e); }}
        onBlur={(e) => { hide(); onBlur?.(e); }}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          // WCAG 1.4.13 — dismissible without moving pointer or focus.
          if (e.key === "Escape" && open) hide();
          onKeyDown?.(e);
        }}
        {...props}
      >
        {trigger}
        <div
          id={tooltipId}
          role="tooltip"
          hidden={!open}
          className={cn(
            "absolute z-50 w-56 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-[12px] text-s4e-text-inverse leading-relaxed pointer-events-none",
            "bg-s4e-neutral-grey-900",
            BUBBLE_POS[position],
          )}
        >
          {content}
          <div
            aria-hidden
            className={cn(
              "absolute border-4",
              ARROW_POS[position],
              ARROW_BORDER[position],
            )}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  },
);
Tooltip.displayName = "Tooltip";
```

<!-- ===== Breadcrumb (breadcrumb) ===== -->

---
title: Breadcrumb
slug: breadcrumb
category: Molecule
status: stable
source: components/ui/breadcrumb.tsx
styleguide: /styleguide/breadcrumb
figma: TBD
apg: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/breadcrumb/
---

# Breadcrumb

Shows where the current page sits in the hierarchy and lets users jump back up.

## Overview

### When to use
- Pages two or more levels deep (Assets / example.com / Finding #123).

### When not to use
- Flat, top-level pages.
- Showing step progress in a flow → a stepper.
- Showing browsing history. Breadcrumbs reflect hierarchy, not history.

## Anatomy

```
① Assets  ② •  ① example.com  ② •  ③ Finding #123
```

1. **Item**: a link to an ancestor page.
2. **Separator**: "•" by default, `aria-hidden`.
3. **Current page**: not a link, `aria-current="page"`.

## States

| State | Visual |
|---|---|
| Link | `text-primary` |
| Hover | `brand-primary-500`, underlined |
| Visited | `text-secondary` |
| Current | `text-secondary`, not interactive |
| Focus | Should show a visible ring (see Known gaps) |

## Content guidelines
- Use the destination page's title as the label, shortened if needed.
- Truncate the middle items on mobile (`Assets / … / Finding`), never the first or last.

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Start at the section root | Start with "Home" when the logo already links home |
| Keep the current page as the last item | Make the current item a link to itself |

## Accessibility

**Pattern:** [APG — Breadcrumb](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/breadcrumb/)

- `<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">` landmark. ✅
- The current item has `aria-current="page"`. ✅
- Separators are `aria-hidden`. ✅
- APG recommends wrapping items in an ordered list (`<ol><li>`) so screen readers announce "list, 3 items". See Known gaps.

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Link / hover | `s4e-text-primary` / `s4e-brand-primary-500` |
| Current / visited / separator | `s4e-text-secondary` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma property | Prop | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Item / State | `isCurrent`, `visited` | Default · Current · Visited |
| Separator | `BreadcrumbSeparator children` | "•" (default) or custom |

## API

| Component | Prop | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Breadcrumb` | …`HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>` | | `<nav>` wrapper |
| `BreadcrumbItem` | `href` | `string` | Link target |
| | `isCurrent` | `boolean` | Renders a `<span aria-current="page">` |
| | `visited` | `boolean` | Visited styling |
| `BreadcrumbSeparator` | `children` | `ReactNode` | Defaults to "•" |

## Examples

```tsx
<Breadcrumb>
  <BreadcrumbItem href="/assets">Assets</BreadcrumbItem>
  <BreadcrumbSeparator />
  <BreadcrumbItem href="/assets/example.com">example.com</BreadcrumbItem>
  <BreadcrumbSeparator />
  <BreadcrumbItem isCurrent>Finding #123</BreadcrumbItem>
</Breadcrumb>
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] No `<ol>/<li>` list semantics.
- [ ] Links have no `focus-visible` style.
- [ ] Renders a plain `<a>`. No `asChild` for Next `<Link>` client-side navigation.
- [ ] No built-in collapse / ellipsis for long paths.

## Related
- [Tabs](./tabs.md)

### Source — `components/ui/breadcrumb.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — Breadcrumb
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/breadcrumb.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 */

export type BreadcrumbProps = React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>;

export const Breadcrumb = React.forwardRef<HTMLElement, BreadcrumbProps>(
  ({ className, children, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <nav
        ref={ref}
        aria-label="Breadcrumb"
        className={cn("flex items-center gap-2", className)}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </nav>
    );
  },
);
Breadcrumb.displayName = "Breadcrumb";

export interface BreadcrumbItemProps
  extends React.AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement> {
  isCurrent?: boolean;
  visited?:   boolean;
}

export const BreadcrumbItem = React.forwardRef<HTMLAnchorElement, BreadcrumbItemProps>(
  ({ className, isCurrent, visited, children, href, ...props }, ref) => {
    if (isCurrent) {
      return (
        <span
          aria-current="page"
          className={cn("text-[14px] text-s4e-text-secondary", className)}
        >
          {children}
        </span>
      );
    }

    return (
      <a
        ref={ref}
        href={href}
        className={cn(
          "text-[14px] font-medium cursor-pointer transition-colors",
          visited
            ? "text-s4e-text-secondary"
            : "text-s4e-text-primary hover:text-s4e-brand-primary-500 hover:underline hover:underline-offset-2",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </a>
    );
  },
);
BreadcrumbItem.displayName = "BreadcrumbItem";

export type BreadcrumbSeparatorProps = React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>;

export const BreadcrumbSeparator = React.forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, BreadcrumbSeparatorProps>(
  ({ className, children, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <span
        ref={ref}
        aria-hidden
        className={cn("text-s4e-text-secondary text-[12px] select-none", className)}
        {...props}
      >
        {children ?? "•"}
      </span>
    );
  },
);
BreadcrumbSeparator.displayName = "BreadcrumbSeparator";
```

<!-- ===== Filter Bar (filter-bar) ===== -->

---
title: Filter Bar
slug: filter-bar
category: Molecule
status: stable
source: components/ui/filter-bar.tsx
styleguide: /styleguide/filter-bar
figma: TBD
apg: N/A (composed of buttons + input; see notes)
---

# Filter Bar

A horizontal toolbar that combines search, filter pills and view actions above a table or list.

## Overview

### When to use
- Above a [Data Table](./data-table.md) or list where users narrow the results by several dimensions.

### When not to use
- One filter → just a [Select](./select.md) or [Search Bar](./search-bar.md).
- Switching between unrelated views → [Tabs](./tabs.md).

## Anatomy

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ① 🔍 Search…  │ ② [Severity ▾] [Status 2 ✕] ③ [+3]  ④ Clear │ ⑤ ⬇ ⚙ │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

1. **FilterSearch**: 32px search input.
2. **FilterPill**: opens a filter. When `active` it's brand-tinted, shows a `count` and a ✕ clear.
3. **FilterOverflow**: "+N" for collapsed pills.
4. **FilterClear**: resets all filters.
5. **FilterAction**: export, columns, settings. Can be icon-only.

`FilterBarGroup` arranges parts (`grow` takes the remaining space). `FilterBarDivider` is a vertical rule (`aria-hidden`).

## States

| Part | State | Visual |
|---|---|---|
| Pill | Default | Divider border, `text-secondary`, chevron |
| Pill | Hover | `neutral-grey-300` border, `text-primary` |
| Pill | Active | `brand-primary-500` border / text, `brand-primary-50` bg, count bubble, ✕ |
| Action | Muted / disabled | Secondary text / `text-disabled`, `not-allowed` |
| Bar | Overflow | Scrolls horizontally on small screens |

## Content guidelines
- Pill label = the dimension ("Severity"), not the value. Show the value count in the bubble.
- Keep "Clear" visible only when at least one filter is active.

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Reflect active filters in the URL | Reset filters on navigation |
| Show the result count after filtering | Leave users guessing whether a filter applied |

## Accessibility
- Wrap it in `role="toolbar"` + `aria-label="Filters"` if arrow-key navigation between controls is implemented. Otherwise a `<div>` with natural Tab order is fine.
- Pills that open a menu: `aria-haspopup` + `aria-expanded`. Active pills: `aria-pressed` or a state in the label.
- `FilterAction iconOnly` gets `aria-label={label}` automatically.
- An active pill's clear ✕ is a **sibling** button (`aria-label="Clear <label>"`) inside the pill's visual container, never nested inside the pill button. `className` styles the container; other props go to the main button.
- Announce result-count changes in a polite live region.

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Bar / pill border | `s4e-border-default` (hover `s4e-border-strong`) |
| Surface | `s4e-surface-app` |
| Active pill | `s4e-brand-primary-500`, `s4e-brand-primary-50` |
| Count bubble | `s4e-brand-primary-500` / `s4e-text-on-accent` |
| Clear | `s4e-text-error` (hover `-700`) |
| Text | `s4e-text-primary`, `s4e-text-secondary`, `s4e-text-disabled` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma part / property | Component / prop |
|---|---|
| Pill / Active | `FilterPill active` |
| Pill / Count | `FilterPill count` |
| Action / Icon only | `FilterAction iconOnly` |
| Action / Muted | `FilterAction muted` |
| +N | `FilterOverflow count` |

## API

| Component | Props |
|---|---|
| `FilterBar` | `HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>` |
| `FilterBarGroup` | `grow?: boolean` |
| `FilterPill` | `label: string`, `icon?`, `count?: number`, `active?: boolean`, `onClear?: () => void`, …button attrs |
| `FilterSearch` | `value?: string`, `onChange?: (v: string) => void`, …input attrs |
| `FilterAction` | `icon` (required), `label: string`, `iconOnly?`, `muted?`, …button attrs |
| `FilterClear` | button attrs; `children` defaults to "Clear" |
| `FilterOverflow` | `count: number` |
| `FilterBarDivider` | div attrs |

## Examples

```tsx
<FilterBar>
  <FilterBarGroup grow>
    <FilterSearch aria-label="Search findings" value={q} onChange={setQ} />
  </FilterBarGroup>
  <FilterPill label="Severity" active count={2} onClear={clearSeverity} aria-haspopup="menu" />
  <FilterPill label="Status" />
  <FilterClear onClick={clearAll} />
  <FilterBarDivider />
  <FilterAction icon={Download} label="Export" iconOnly aria-label="Export" />
</FilterBar>
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] No popover / menu for pills. Consumers must build the dropdown.
- [ ] `FilterSearch` duplicates [Search Bar](./search-bar.md). Use a Search Bar `size="sm"` instead.

## Related
- [Search Bar](./search-bar.md) · [Data Table](./data-table.md) · [Select](./select.md)

### Source — `components/ui/filter-bar.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { Search, ChevronDown, X, Plus } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — FilterBar
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/filter-bar.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 */

type IconComponent = React.ComponentType<{ size?: number; className?: string }>;

export type FilterBarProps = React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>;

export const FilterBar = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, FilterBarProps>(
  ({ className, children, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "border border-s4e-border-default rounded-xl p-3 overflow-x-auto s4e-scrollbar-hide",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-max md:w-auto">{children}</div>
      </div>
    );
  },
);
FilterBar.displayName = "FilterBar";

export interface FilterBarGroupProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  grow?: boolean;
}

export const FilterBarGroup = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, FilterBarGroupProps>(
  ({ className, grow, children, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "flex items-center gap-2",
          grow ? "md:flex-1 md:min-w-0" : "shrink-0",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    );
  },
);
FilterBarGroup.displayName = "FilterBarGroup";

export interface FilterPillProps extends Omit<React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, "onClear"> {
  label:    string;
  icon?:    IconComponent;
  count?:   number;
  active?:  boolean;
  onClear?: () => void;
}

export const FilterPill = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, FilterPillProps>(
  ({ label, icon: Icon, count, active, onClear, className, ...props }, ref) => {
    const clearable = active && onClear;
    // The pill and its clear action are sibling buttons inside one visual
    // container — nesting a button inside a button is invalid and confuses AT.
    return (
      <span
        className={cn(
          "inline-flex items-center h-8 rounded-lg border text-[12px] font-medium select-none transition-colors shrink-0",
          active
            ? "border-s4e-brand-primary-500 bg-s4e-bg-brand-subtle text-s4e-brand-primary-500"
            : "border-s4e-border-default bg-s4e-surface-app text-s4e-text-secondary hover:border-s4e-border-strong hover:text-s4e-text-primary",
          className,
        )}
      >
        <button
          ref={ref}
          type="button"
          className={cn(
            "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-full pl-2.5 rounded-lg cursor-pointer",
            "focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-s4e-focus-ring",
            clearable ? "pr-1" : "pr-2.5",
          )}
          {...props}
        >
          {Icon && <Icon size={12} aria-hidden className="opacity-70 shrink-0" />}
          <span>{label}</span>
          {count !== undefined && (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-s4e-brand-primary-500 text-s4e-text-on-accent text-[10px] font-bold">
              {count}
            </span>
          )}
          {!clearable && <ChevronDown size={11} aria-hidden className="opacity-50" />}
        </button>
        {clearable && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClear}
            aria-label={`Clear ${label}`}
            className="inline-flex items-center h-full pl-0.5 pr-2.5 rounded-lg cursor-pointer hover:opacity-70 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-s4e-focus-ring"
          >
            <X size={11} aria-hidden />
          </button>
        )}
      </span>
    );
  },
);
FilterPill.displayName = "FilterPill";

export interface FilterSearchProps
  extends Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, "onChange" | "value"> {
  value?:    string;
  onChange?: (value: string) => void;
}

export const FilterSearch = React.forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, FilterSearchProps>(
  ({ value, onChange, placeholder = "Search…", className, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <div className="relative flex items-center shrink-0">
        <Search size={13} className="absolute left-3 text-s4e-text-secondary pointer-events-none" />
        <input
          ref={ref}
          type="text"
          placeholder={placeholder}
          value={value ?? ""}
          onChange={(e) => onChange?.(e.target.value)}
          className={cn(
            "h-8 w-48 pl-8 pr-3 rounded-lg border border-s4e-border-default bg-s4e-surface-app text-[12px] text-s4e-text-primary placeholder:text-s4e-text-secondary outline-none focus:border-s4e-brand-primary-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-s4e-focus-ring/20 transition-colors",
            className,
          )}
          {...props}
        />
      </div>
    );
  },
);
FilterSearch.displayName = "FilterSearch";

export interface FilterActionProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  icon:      IconComponent;
  label:     string;
  iconOnly?: boolean;
  muted?:    boolean;
}

export const FilterAction = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, FilterActionProps>(
  ({ icon: Icon, label, iconOnly, muted, className, disabled, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <button
        ref={ref}
        type="button"
        title={label}
        aria-label={iconOnly ? label : undefined}
        disabled={disabled || muted}
        className={cn(
          "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-8 rounded-lg border text-[12px] font-medium transition-colors shrink-0",
          iconOnly ? "w-8 justify-center" : "px-3",
          muted
            ? "border-s4e-border-default bg-s4e-surface-app text-s4e-text-disabled cursor-not-allowed"
            : "border-s4e-border-default bg-s4e-surface-app text-s4e-text-secondary hover:text-s4e-text-primary hover:border-s4e-border-strong",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <Icon size={13} />
        {!iconOnly && label}
      </button>
    );
  },
);
FilterAction.displayName = "FilterAction";

export type FilterClearProps = React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>;

export const FilterClear = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, FilterClearProps>(
  ({ className, children = "Clear", ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <button
        ref={ref}
        type="button"
        className={cn(
          "inline-flex items-center gap-1 h-8 px-2.5 text-[12px] font-medium text-s4e-text-error hover:text-s4e-scale-red-700 transition-colors shrink-0",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <X size={13} />
        {children}
      </button>
    );
  },
);
FilterClear.displayName = "FilterClear";

export interface FilterOverflowProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  count: number;
}

export const FilterOverflow = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, FilterOverflowProps>(
  ({ count, className, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <button
        ref={ref}
        type="button"
        className={cn(
          "inline-flex items-center gap-1 h-8 px-3 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-s4e-border-default text-[12px] font-medium text-s4e-text-secondary hover:border-s4e-brand-primary-500 hover:text-s4e-brand-primary-500 transition-colors shrink-0",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <Plus size={12} />
        {count}
      </button>
    );
  },
);
FilterOverflow.displayName = "FilterOverflow";

export type FilterBarDividerProps = React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>;

export const FilterBarDivider = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, FilterBarDividerProps>(
  ({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        aria-hidden
        className={cn("w-px h-5 bg-s4e-border-default shrink-0", className)}
        {...props}
      />
    );
  },
);
FilterBarDivider.displayName = "FilterBarDivider";
```

<!-- ===== Search Bar (search-bar) ===== -->

---
title: Search Bar
slug: search-bar
category: Molecule
