# Search Bar

A text input dedicated to searching or filtering content, with a search icon and a clear button.

## Overview

### When to use
- Free-text search across a page, table or the whole product.

### When not to use
- Form data entry → [Text Field](./text-field.md).
- Combined with filter pills → use `FilterSearch` inside [Filter Bar](./filter-bar.md).
- Global navigation search → the ⌘K command palette.

## Anatomy

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ① 🔍  ② Search…                ③ ✕   │
└──────────────────────────────────────┘
```

1. **Search icon**: decorative; turns brand colour while focused.
2. **Input**: placeholder "Search…".
3. **Clear button**: visible when there's a value and `clearable`; `aria-label="Clear search"`.

## Variants

| `variant` | Use for |
|---|---|
| `default` | On page surfaces: bordered field |
| `ghost` | Inside toolbars / headers: grey-filled, no visible border until focused |

## States

| State | Visual |
|---|---|
| Default | `default`: border `neutral-divider-10` on `surface-app`; `ghost`: `neutral-grey-100` fill |
| Focus | Brand-500 border + 2px brand/20 ring, icon turns brand (`focus-within`) |
| Filled | Clear button shown |
| Disabled | Muted text, `not-allowed` |

## Content guidelines
- Placeholder names the scope: "Search assets", "Search findings by CVE".
- Show the result count near the results ("12 results"), not in the input.

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Debounce (~250ms) remote searches | Fire a request on every keystroke |
| Keep the query in the URL (`?q=`) | Lose the query on reload |

## Accessibility

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `Escape` | Should clear the query (recommended) |
| `Enter` | Submit (if it isn't live filtering) |

- Use `type="search"` (implicit `role="searchbox"`) and give it a name: `aria-label="Search assets"` when there's no visible label.
- Wrap it in `<search>` / `role="search"` when it's the page's main search.
- Announce result-count changes in a polite live region.

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Border | `s4e-border-default` |
| Ghost fill | `s4e-bg-subtle` |
| Surface | `s4e-surface-app` |
| Icon / clear | `s4e-text-secondary` → focus `s4e-brand-primary-500` |
| Text / placeholder | `s4e-text-primary` / `s4e-text-secondary` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma property | Prop | Values |
|---|---|---|
| Variant | `variant` | Default · Ghost |
| Clearable | `clearable` | true / false |
| State = Disabled | `disabled` | true / false |

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string` | — | Controlled value |
| `onChange` | `(value: string) => void` | — | Called with the string (not the event) |
| `onClear` | `() => void` | — | Called by ✕ |
| `clearable` | `boolean` | `true` | Shows ✕ when filled |
| `variant` | `"default" \| "ghost"` | `"default"` | Style |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `"Search…"` | — |
| …rest | `InputHTMLAttributes` | — | Forwarded to `<input>` |

## Examples

```tsx
<SearchBar aria-label="Search assets" placeholder="Search assets" value={q} onChange={setQ} onClear={() => setQ("")} />
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] Renders `type="text"`, not `type="search"`, and has no accessible name unless the consumer passes `aria-label`.
- [ ] `Escape` doesn't clear the input.
- [ ] No size scale (`sm` for toolbars). `FilterSearch` duplicates a 32px version.

## Related
- [Filter Bar](./filter-bar.md) · [Text Field](./text-field.md) · [Data Table](./data-table.md)

### Source — `components/ui/search-bar.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { Search, X } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — SearchBar
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/search-bar.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 */

type Variant = "default" | "ghost";

export interface SearchBarProps
  extends Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, "onChange" | "value"> {
  variant?:    Variant;
  value?:      string;
  onChange?:   (value: string) => void;
  onClear?:    () => void;
  clearable?:  boolean;
  className?:  string;
}

const CONTAINER_BASE =
  "flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 h-9 w-full transition-colors";

const VARIANT_CONTAINER: Record<Variant, string> = {
  default:
    "border border-s4e-border-default bg-s4e-surface-app " +
    "focus-within:border-s4e-brand-primary-500 focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-s4e-focus-ring/20",
  ghost:
    "bg-s4e-bg-subtle border border-transparent " +
    "focus-within:border-s4e-brand-primary-500 focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-s4e-focus-ring/20",
};

const INPUT_BASE =
  "flex-1 bg-transparent text-[14px] outline-none placeholder:text-s4e-text-secondary " +
  "text-s4e-text-primary disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-s4e-text-disabled";

export const SearchBar = React.forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, SearchBarProps>(
  (
    {
      variant     = "default",
      value,
      onChange,
      onClear,
      clearable   = true,
      placeholder = "Search…",
      disabled,
      className,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    const hasClear = clearable && !!value && !disabled;

    const handleClear = () => {
      onClear?.();
      onChange?.("");
    };

    return (
      <div
        className={cn(
          CONTAINER_BASE,
          VARIANT_CONTAINER[variant],
          disabled && "opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed",
          className,
        )}
      >
        <Search
          size={14}
          className="shrink-0 text-s4e-text-secondary group-focus-within:text-s4e-brand-primary-500"
        />
        <input
          ref={ref}
          type="text"
          disabled={disabled}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          value={value ?? ""}
          onChange={(e) => onChange?.(e.target.value)}
          className={INPUT_BASE}
          {...props}
        />
        {hasClear && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleClear}
            className="shrink-0 text-s4e-text-secondary hover:text-s4e-text-primary transition-colors"
            aria-label="Clear search"
          >
            <X size={13} />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  },
);
SearchBar.displayName = "SearchBar";
```

<!-- ===== Tabs (tabs) ===== -->

---
title: Tabs
slug: tabs
category: Molecule
status: stable
source: components/ui/tabs.tsx
styleguide: /styleguide/tabs
figma: TBD
apg: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/tabs/
---

# Tabs

Switches between related views of the same object without leaving the page.

## Overview

### When to use
- 2–7 peer views of one entity (Overview · Findings · Assets · Settings).
- The content of each tab makes sense on its own.

### When not to use
- Sequential steps → a stepper (not built yet).
- Navigating to different pages → navigation links (sidebar, breadcrumb).
- Toggling a filter on one dataset → a segmented control or [Filter Bar](./filter-bar.md).
- Comparing content side by side → users can't see two tabs at once.

## Anatomy

```
 ① Overview   Findings   Assets
 ━━━━━━━━━━                       ② active indicator
───────────────────────────────── ③ baseline divider
 ④ Panel content
```

1. **Trigger**: 14px / 500 label.
2. **Active indicator**: 2px brand underline.
3. **Divider**: `neutral-divider-10`, full width.
4. **Panel**: only the active panel is rendered.

## States

| State | Visual |
|---|---|
| Inactive | `text-secondary`, no underline |
| Hover | `text-primary` |
| Active | `text-primary` + brand underline |
| Focus | Inset 2px brand/40 ring (`focus-visible`) |
| Disabled | 50% opacity, not clickable |

## Content guidelines
- 1–2 words, nouns, sentence case. No icons-only tabs.
- Counts may follow the label ("Findings 12"). Keep them in the same trigger.

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Keep the tab order stable | Reorder tabs based on data |
| Sync the active tab to the URL for deep links | Lose the selected tab on reload |
| Use one row of tabs | Nest tabs inside tabs |

## Accessibility

**Pattern:** [APG — Tabs](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/tabs/)

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `Tab` | Focus moves to the **active** tab, then into the panel |
| `←` / `→` | Previous / next tab (wrapping) |
| `Home` / `End` | First / last tab |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Activate (if activation is manual) |

- `tablist` (`aria-orientation="horizontal"`), `tab` (`aria-selected`, `aria-controls`), `tabpanel` (`aria-labelledby`, `tabIndex=0`).
- Roving tabindex: only the active tab is a Tab stop. Arrow keys move focus **and** activate (automatic activation).
- Give the `TabsList` an `aria-label` describing the set.

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Inactive / active text | `s4e-text-secondary` / `s4e-text-primary` |
| Indicator / focus ring | `s4e-brand-primary-500` |
| Divider | `s4e-border-default` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma property | Code |
|---|---|
| Tab / State = Active | `Tabs value` equals `TabsTrigger value` |
| Tab / Disabled | `TabsTrigger disabled` |

## API

| Component | Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Tabs` | `value` | `string` | — | Controlled active tab |
| | `defaultValue` | `string` | `""` | Uncontrolled initial tab |
| | `onValueChange` | `(v: string) => void` | — | Change handler |
| `TabsList` | …`HTMLAttributes` | | | Renders `role="tablist"` |
| `TabsTrigger` | `value` | `string` | — | **Required** |
| `TabsContent` | `value` | `string` | — | **Required**; rendered only when active |

## Examples

```tsx
<Tabs defaultValue="overview">
  <TabsList aria-label="Asset sections">
    <TabsTrigger value="overview">Overview</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="findings">Findings</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="overview">…</TabsContent>
  <TabsContent value="findings">…</TabsContent>
</Tabs>
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] The 1.1 CHANGELOG says Tabs uses `@base-ui/react`, but it's a hand-rolled implementation. Correct the CHANGELOG note, or migrate.
- [ ] No manual-activation mode (`activationMode="manual"`) for tabs whose panels are expensive to render.
- [ ] No overflow handling (scroll buttons) for many tabs on narrow screens.

## Related
- [Breadcrumb](./breadcrumb.md) · [Filter Bar](./filter-bar.md)

### Source — `components/ui/tabs.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — Tabs
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/tabs.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   <Tabs defaultValue="overview">
 *     <TabsList>
 *       <TabsTrigger value="overview">Overview</TabsTrigger>
 *       <TabsTrigger value="details">Details</TabsTrigger>
 *     </TabsList>
 *     <TabsContent value="overview">…</TabsContent>
 *     <TabsContent value="details">…</TabsContent>
 *   </Tabs>
 */

type TabsContextValue = {
  value:    string;
  setValue: (v: string) => void;
  baseId:   string;
};

const idFor = (baseId: string, part: "trigger" | "panel", value: string) =>
  `${baseId}-${part}-${value.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g, "_")}`;

const TabsContext = React.createContext<TabsContextValue | null>(null);

function useTabs(): TabsContextValue {
  const ctx = React.useContext(TabsContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("Tabs.* must be used inside <Tabs>");
  return ctx;
}

export interface TabsProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** Controlled active value. */
  value?:        string;
  /** Uncontrolled initial value. */
  defaultValue?: string;
  onValueChange?: (v: string) => void;
}

export const Tabs = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, TabsProps>(
  ({ className, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, children, ...props }, ref) => {
    const baseId       = React.useId();
    const isControlled = value !== undefined;
    const [internal, setInternal] = React.useState(defaultValue ?? "");
    const current = isControlled ? (value as string) : internal;
    const setValue = (v: string) => {
      if (!isControlled) setInternal(v);
      onValueChange?.(v);
    };
    return (
      <TabsContext.Provider value={{ value: current, setValue, baseId }}>
        <div ref={ref} data-slot="tabs" className={cn("flex flex-col gap-6", className)} {...props}>
          {children}
        </div>
      </TabsContext.Provider>
    );
  },
);
Tabs.displayName = "Tabs";

// Arrow / Home / End move focus between tabs and activate them (APG
// "automatic activation"). Only the active tab is in the Tab order.
export const TabsList = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(
  ({ className, onKeyDown, ...props }, ref) => {
    const listRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    React.useImperativeHandle(ref, () => listRef.current as HTMLDivElement);
    const { value } = useTabs();

    const tabs = () =>
      Array.from(
        listRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('[role="tab"]:not([disabled])') ?? [],
      );

    // With no matching active tab, keep the first tab reachable by Tab.
    React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
      const all = tabs();
      if (all.length && !all.some((t) => t.tabIndex === 0)) all[0].tabIndex = 0;
    }, [value]);

    const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
      onKeyDown?.(e);
      if (e.defaultPrevented) return;
      const all = tabs();
      const index = all.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLButtonElement);
      if (index < 0) return;
      let next: number | null = null;
      if (e.key === "ArrowRight") next = (index + 1) % all.length;
      if (e.key === "ArrowLeft")  next = (index - 1 + all.length) % all.length;
      if (e.key === "Home")       next = 0;
      if (e.key === "End")        next = all.length - 1;
      if (next === null) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      all[next].focus();
      all[next].click();
    };

    return (
      <div
        ref={listRef}
        role="tablist"
        aria-orientation="horizontal"
        data-slot="tabs-list"
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        className={cn(
          "flex items-end border-b border-s4e-border-default overflow-x-auto s4e-scrollbar-hide",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      />
    );
  },
);
TabsList.displayName = "TabsList";

export interface TabsTriggerProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  value: string;
}

export const TabsTrigger = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, TabsTriggerProps>(
  ({ className, value, ...props }, ref) => {
    const { value: current, setValue, baseId } = useTabs();
    const isActive = current === value;
    return (
      <button
        ref={ref}
        type="button"
        role="tab"
        id={idFor(baseId, "trigger", value)}
        aria-selected={isActive}
        aria-controls={isActive ? idFor(baseId, "panel", value) : undefined}
        tabIndex={isActive ? 0 : -1}
        data-slot="tabs-trigger"
        onClick={() => setValue(value)}
        className={cn(
          "inline-flex items-center px-4 pt-2 pb-2.5 -mb-px text-[14px] font-medium whitespace-nowrap tracking-tight shrink-0",
          "border-b-[2px] transition-colors cursor-pointer",
          "focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-s4e-focus-ring/40",
          "disabled:opacity-50 disabled:pointer-events-none",
          isActive
            ? "text-s4e-text-primary border-s4e-brand-primary-500"
            : "text-s4e-text-secondary border-transparent hover:text-s4e-text-primary",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      />
    );
  },
);
TabsTrigger.displayName = "TabsTrigger";

export interface TabsContentProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  value: string;
}

export const TabsContent = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, TabsContentProps>(
  ({ className, value, ...props }, ref) => {
    const { value: current, baseId } = useTabs();
    if (current !== value) return null;
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role="tabpanel"
        id={idFor(baseId, "panel", value)}
        aria-labelledby={idFor(baseId, "trigger", value)}
        tabIndex={0}
        data-slot="tabs-content"
        className={cn("outline-none", className)}
        {...props}
      />
    );
  },
);
TabsContent.displayName = "TabsContent";
```
