# Cards

Dashboard cards that summarise a topic and lead to a next step. There are two presets: **InsightCard** (a key/value list) and **AlertCard** (an active-issue callout).

## Overview

### When to use
- **InsightCard:** a compact summary of 3–6 metrics with an optional "view more" action.
- **AlertCard:** highlighting active issues that need attention, with a count and a CTA.

### When not to use
- Charts → [Chart](./chart.md) `ChartCard`.
- Tabular records → [Data Table](./data-table.md).
- A generic container. There's also `components/ui/card.tsx` (shadcn); see Known gaps.

## Anatomy

```
InsightCard                       AlertCard
┌──────────────────────────┐      ┌──────────────────────────────┐
│ ① Title                  │      │ ① Title       ② ● 3 active   │
│ ② Label ........ Value   │      │ ③ Alert title  [badge]       │
│   Label ........ Value   │      │ ④ Description…               │
│ ③ Action →               │      │ ⑤ [Action]                   │
└──────────────────────────┘      └──────────────────────────────┘
```

InsightCard: ① title · ② rows (12px label / 14px semibold value) · ③ optional action.
AlertCard: ① title · ② pulsing active count · ③ alert title + optional badge · ④ description · ⑤ action.

Shared shell: 12px radius (`rounded-xl`), 1px divider border, `surface-app`, 20px padding.

## States

| Part | State | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| Action | Hover / focus | Link-style brand colour |
| Active count dot | Animated pulse | Stops under reduced motion |

## Content guidelines
- Titles are nouns ("Exposure summary"). Values are formatted (`1,204`, `98.2%`).
- AlertCard description: what happened + the impact in one sentence.

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Keep cards in a grid of equal heights | Mix card heights in one row |
| Make only the action clickable | Make the whole card and the inner button both clickable |

## Accessibility
- Card titles should be headings (`h3`) so dashboard sections are navigable. Today they're `<span>`s.
- The pulsing dot is decorative. The count must be text ("3 active").
- Action buttons must describe their target ("View all 3 alerts"), not just "View".

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Shell | `s4e-surface-app`, `s4e-border-default` |
| Title / value / label | `s4e-text-primary` / `s4e-text-primary` / `s4e-text-secondary` |
| Action | `s4e-brand-primary-500` (hover `-600`) |
| Active pill | `s4e-bg-error-subtle` / `s4e-scale-red-500` / `s4e-text-error` |
| Badge | `s4e-bg-subtle` / `s4e-text-secondary` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma component | Code |
|---|---|
| Card / Insight | `InsightCard` (`title`, `rows`, `actionLabel`) |
| Card / Alert | `AlertCard` (`title`, `activeCount`, `alertTitle`, `alertBadge`, `description`, `action`) |

## API

**InsightCard**

| Prop | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | `string` | **Required** |
| `rows` | `{ label: string; value: string \| number }[]` | **Required** |
| `actionLabel` | `string` | Shows the action when set |
| `onActionClick` | `() => void` | — |

**AlertCard**

| Prop | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | `string` | **Required** |
| `activeCount` | `number` | **Required** |
| `alertTitle` | `string` | **Required** |
| `alertBadge` | `string` | Optional badge |
| `description` | `string` | **Required** |
| `action` | `string` | **Required** CTA label |
| `onActionClick` | `() => void` | — |

## Examples

```tsx
<InsightCard
  title="Exposure summary"
  rows={[{ label: "Open ports", value: 14 }, { label: "Expired certs", value: 2 }]}
  actionLabel="View details"
  onActionClick={open}
/>
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] **Two card systems.** `card.tsx` (shadcn, uses `bg-card` / `text-card-foreground`) and `cards.tsx` (s4e tokens) coexist. Pick one generic `Card` primitive on s4e tokens and build InsightCard / AlertCard on it.
- [ ] Titles aren't headings. There's no `headingLevel` prop.
- [ ] No loading (Skeleton) or empty state preset.

## Related
- [Chart](./chart.md) · [Gauge](./gauge.md) · [Badge](./badge-tag.md)

### Source — `components/ui/cards.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { ArrowRight } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — Cards
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/cards.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 */

export type InsightRow = { label: string; value: string | number };

export interface InsightCardProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  title:           string;
  rows:            InsightRow[];
  actionLabel?:    string;
  onActionClick?:  () => void;
}

export const InsightCard = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, InsightCardProps>(
  ({ title, rows, actionLabel = "View Details", onActionClick, className, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "border border-s4e-border-default rounded-xl px-5 py-5 bg-s4e-surface-app flex flex-col gap-4",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-s4e-text-primary">{title}</div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onActionClick}
            className="text-[12px] font-medium text-s4e-brand-primary-500 hover:text-s4e-brand-primary-600 transition-colors"
          >
            {actionLabel}
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-0 divide-y divide-s4e-border-default">
          {rows.map((row) => (
            <div key={row.label} className="flex items-center justify-between py-2.5">
              <span className="text-[12px] text-s4e-text-secondary">{row.label}</span>
              <span className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-s4e-text-primary">{row.value}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  },
);
InsightCard.displayName = "InsightCard";

export interface AlertCardProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  title:         string;
  activeCount:   number;
  alertTitle:    string;
  alertBadge?:   string;
  description:   string;
  action:        string;
  onActionClick?: () => void;
}

export const AlertCard = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, AlertCardProps>(
  (
    {
      title,
      activeCount,
      alertTitle,
      alertBadge,
      description,
      action,
      onActionClick,
      className,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-s4e-border-default bg-s4e-surface-app",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-2 bg-s4e-bg-subtle border-b border-s4e-border-default">
          <span className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-s4e-text-primary">{title}</span>
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-s4e-bg-error-subtle text-[11px] font-semibold text-s4e-text-error">
            <span className="s4e-pulse-dot w-[6px] h-[6px] rounded-full bg-s4e-scale-red-500 shrink-0" />
            {activeCount} Active
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="px-4 py-4 space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <span className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-s4e-text-primary">{alertTitle}</span>
              {alertBadge && (
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-s4e-bg-subtle text-[10px] font-medium text-s4e-text-secondary">
                  {alertBadge}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <p className="text-[12px] text-s4e-text-secondary leading-relaxed">{description}</p>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onActionClick}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[12px] font-medium text-s4e-brand-primary-500 hover:text-s4e-brand-primary-600 transition-colors group"
          >
            {action}
            <ArrowRight size={12} className="transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-0.5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  },
);
AlertCard.displayName = "AlertCard";
```

<!-- ===== Chart (chart) ===== -->

---
title: Chart
slug: chart
category: Organism
status: stable
source: components/ui/chart.tsx
styleguide: /styleguide/chart
figma: TBD
apg: N/A (see data-viz accessibility notes)
---

# Chart

A dependency-free set of SVG chart primitives in a shared card shell: donut, bar, line and treemap, plus stat blocks.

## Overview

### When to use

| Question the user asks | Use |
|---|---|
| "How is the total split?" (≤ 6 parts) | `DonutChart` + `DonutLegend` |
| "Which category is biggest?" | `BarChart` |
| "How did it change over time?" | `LineChart` |
| "Which areas dominate a hierarchy?" | `TreemapChart` |
| "What's the headline number?" | `StatBlock` |

### When not to use
- A single bounded value → [Gauge](./gauge.md).
- More than ~6 donut segments → use a bar chart.
- Exact values users need to read or copy → [Data Table](./data-table.md).

## Anatomy

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ① Title   ② description…      ③ trailing  View all │  ChartCard header
│                                                │
│ ④ chart body (Donut / Bar / Line / Treemap)    │
│ ⑤ legend                                       │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

1. **Title** · 2. **Description** (hidden < `sm`) · 3. **Trailing slot** (e.g. a period select) + "View all" · 4. **Chart** · 5. **Legend**.

## Variants
- `BarChart highlightLeader` emphasises the largest bar.
- `LineChart showArea` fills under the line with a gradient (`gradientId` must be unique per page).
- `DonutChart showTotal` shows the sum in the centre.
- `DonutLegend fullWidth` stretches the legend rows.

## Content guidelines
- Title says *what* is measured; description says the period / scope ("Last 30 days").
- Axis labels: rounded, with units (`1.5k`, `40%`). Don't repeat the unit on every tick.
- Colour by **meaning**: severity charts must use the `s4e-severity-*` palette, the same as [Severity Badge](./severity-badge.md).

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Start bar axes at 0 | Truncate the axis to exaggerate differences |
| Label segments directly or with a legend in the same order | Use colour as the only key |
| Keep one chart per card | Put two unrelated charts in one card |

## Accessibility
- `DonutChart`, `BarChart`, `LineChart` and `TreemapChart` render as `role="img"` with an auto-generated `aria-label` that summarises the data ("Total 17: Critical 6, High 11"). Pass your own `aria-label` with the **takeaway** ("Critical findings rose from 4 to 11 over 30 days"). That's better than a list of numbers.
- Provide the underlying numbers as text: the legend values, or a visually hidden `<table>`.
- Non-text contrast: adjacent segments and lines need 3:1 against the background and each other, or a separator stroke.
- Don't animate charts when reduced motion is on.

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Card | `s4e-surface-app`, `s4e-border-default` |
| Text | `s4e-text-primary`, `s4e-text-secondary` |
| Series / accent | `s4e-brand-primary-500/600`, `--s4e-data-*` palette |
| Gridlines / track | `s4e-neutral-grey-100` |
| Severity series | `--s4e-severity-{critical,high,medium,low,info}` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma component | Code |
|---|---|
| Chart card | `ChartCard` (`title`, `description`, `viewAll`, `trailing`) |
| Stat | `StatBlock` (`label`, `value`, `accent`) |
| Donut / Bar / Line / Treemap | `DonutChart` · `BarChart` · `LineChart` · `TreemapChart` |

## API

| Component | Key props |
|---|---|
| `ChartCard` | `title: string`, `description?`, `viewAll?: boolean`, `onViewAll?`, `trailing?: ReactNode` |
| `StatBlock` | `label: string`, `value: string`, `accent?: string` |
| `DonutChart` | `data: DonutSegment[]`, `size?: number`, `showTotal?: boolean` |
| `DonutLegend` | `data: DonutSegment[]`, `fullWidth?: boolean` |
| `BarChart` | `data: BarDatum[]`, `max?`, `ticks?: number[]`, `height?` (240), `highlightLeader?` (true) |
| `LineChart` | `linePath: string` (SVG path in a 0–100 viewBox), `yLabels?`, `xLabels?`, `showArea?` (true), `gradientId?` |
| `TreemapChart` | `primary: TreemapBlock[]`, `secondary?: TreemapBlock[]`, `height?` |

## Examples

```tsx
<ChartCard title="Findings by severity" description="Last 30 days" viewAll onViewAll={openFindings}>
  <DonutChart data={segments} showTotal aria-label="42 findings: 6 critical, 11 high, 25 other" />
  <DonutLegend data={segments} />
</ChartCard>
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] `LineChart`'s auto label only knows the axis range, not the values. Always pass a takeaway `aria-label`.
- [ ] `LineChart` takes a pre-computed `linePath` string instead of data points. Designers and devs can't map Figma data to it. Accept `{ x, y }[]` and compute the path.
- [ ] No tooltips or hover values. No responsive resizing beyond CSS width.
- [ ] `recharts` is listed in `package.json` but nothing imports it. Remove it, or adopt it here and drop the hand-rolled SVG.
- [ ] 10px axis labels are below the recommended minimum. Use 11–12px.

## Related
- [Gauge](./gauge.md) · [Cards](./cards.md) · [Severity Badge](./severity-badge.md) · [Data Table](./data-table.md)

### Source — `components/ui/chart.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — Chart
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/chart.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 */

// ── Card wrapper ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ChartCardProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  title:        string;
  description?: string;
  viewAll?:     boolean;
  trailing?:    React.ReactNode;
  onViewAll?:   () => void;
}

export const ChartCard = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ChartCardProps>(
  ({ className, title, description, viewAll, trailing, onViewAll, children, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn("border border-s4e-border-default rounded-xl bg-s4e-surface-app", className)}
        {...props}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 sm:px-5 py-3 bg-s4e-bg-subtle border-b border-s4e-border-default rounded-t-xl">
          <span className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-s4e-text-primary shrink-0">{title}</span>
          {description && (
            <span className="hidden sm:inline text-[12px] text-s4e-text-secondary truncate flex-1 min-w-0">{description}</span>
          )}
          {trailing}
          {viewAll && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onViewAll}
              className="ml-auto text-[12px] font-medium text-s4e-brand-primary-500 hover:text-s4e-brand-primary-600 transition-colors shrink-0 underline underline-offset-2"
            >
              View all
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="px-4 sm:px-5 py-5">{children}</div>
      </div>
    );
  },
);
ChartCard.displayName = "ChartCard";

// ── Stat block ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface StatBlockProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  label:   string;
  value:   string;
  accent?: string;
}

export const StatBlock = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, StatBlockProps>(
  ({ className, label, value, accent, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn("flex-1 min-w-0 rounded-lg bg-s4e-bg-subtle px-4 py-3", className)}
        {...props}
      >
        <div className="text-[12px] text-s4e-text-secondary mb-1 truncate">{label}</div>
        <div className={cn("text-[16px] font-bold tabular-nums truncate", accent ?? "text-s4e-text-primary")}>
          {value}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  },
);
StatBlock.displayName = "StatBlock";

// ── Donut ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type DonutSegment = { label: string; value: number; color: string };

export interface DonutChartProps extends React.SVGAttributes<SVGSVGElement> {
  data:    DonutSegment[];
  size?:   number;
  showTotal?: boolean;
}

export const DonutChart = React.forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, DonutChartProps>(
  ({ data, size = 180, showTotal = true, className, ...props }, ref) => {
    const total = data.reduce((s, d) => s + d.value, 0);
    const RADIUS = 70;
    const STROKE = 28;
    const PATH_LEN = 100;

    let offset = 0;
    const segments = data.map((d) => {
      const dash = (d.value / total) * PATH_LEN;
      const seg  = { ...d, dash, offset };
      offset += dash;
      return seg;
    });

    return (
      <svg
        ref={ref}
        width={size}
        height={size}
        viewBox="-90 -90 180 180"
        role="img"
        aria-label={`Total ${total.toLocaleString()}: ${summarize(data)}`}
        className={cn("shrink-0", className)}
        {...props}
      >
        <circle r={RADIUS} fill="none" stroke="var(--s4e-neutral-grey-100)" strokeWidth={STROKE} />
        {segments.map((s) => (
          <circle
            key={s.label}
            r={RADIUS}
            fill="none"
            stroke={s.color}
            strokeWidth={STROKE}
            pathLength={PATH_LEN}
            strokeDasharray={`${s.dash} ${PATH_LEN - s.dash}`}
            strokeDashoffset={-s.offset}
            transform="rotate(-90)"
          />
        ))}
        {showTotal && (
          <text x="0" y="6" textAnchor="middle" className="fill-s4e-text-primary" fontSize="22" fontWeight="600">
            {total.toLocaleString()}
          </text>
        )}
      </svg>
    );
  },
);
DonutChart.displayName = "DonutChart";

export interface DonutLegendProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  data:       DonutSegment[];
  fullWidth?: boolean;
}

export const DonutLegend = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, DonutLegendProps>(
  ({ data, fullWidth = false, className, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "divide-y divide-s4e-border-default",
          fullWidth ? "w-full" : "flex-1 min-w-0 sm:min-w-[200px]",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {data.map((d) => (
          <div key={d.label} className="flex items-center gap-3 py-2.5">
            <span className="w-[10px] h-[10px] rounded-full shrink-0" style={{ backgroundColor: d.color }} />
            <span className="text-[14px] text-s4e-text-primary flex-1">{d.label}</span>
            <span className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-s4e-text-primary tabular-nums">
              {d.value.toLocaleString()}
            </span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  },
);
DonutLegend.displayName = "DonutLegend";

// Charts are exposed to assistive tech as a single image whose name is a
// text summary of the data. Pass `aria-label` to replace it with the
// takeaway ("Critical findings doubled this month").
const summarize = (data: { label: string; value: number }[]) =>
  data.map((d) => `${d.label} ${d.value.toLocaleString()}`).join(", ");

// ── Bar ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type BarDatum = { label: string; value: number };

export interface BarChartProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  data:      BarDatum[];
  max?:      number;
  ticks?:    number[];
  height?:   number;
  highlightLeader?: boolean;
}

export const BarChart = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, BarChartProps>(
  (
    {
      data,
      max,
      ticks,
      height = 240,
      highlightLeader = true,
      className,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    const computedMax  = max ?? Math.max(...data.map((d) => d.value));
    const computedTicks = ticks ?? [0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50].filter((t) => t <= computedMax || t === 0);
    const finalTicks   = computedTicks.length > 1 ? computedTicks : [0, computedMax];

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role="img"
        aria-label={summarize(data)}
        className={cn("space-y-4", className)}
        {...props}
      >
        <div className="flex gap-3">
          {/* Y axis labels */}
          <div
            className="flex flex-col-reverse justify-between text-right pr-1 w-8"
            style={{ height }}
          >
            {finalTicks.map((t) => (
              <span key={t} className="text-[10px] text-s4e-text-secondary tabular-nums">{t}</span>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Chart area */}
          <div className="flex-1 relative">
            <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col-reverse justify-between pointer-events-none">
              {finalTicks.map((t) => (
                <div key={t} className="border-t border-s4e-border-default/70" />
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="relative flex items-end gap-2 sm:gap-6" style={{ height }}>
              {data.map((b, i) => (
                <div key={b.label} className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-end gap-1.5 h-full">
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-s4e-text-primary tabular-nums">{b.value}</span>
                  <div
                    className={cn(
                      "w-full max-w-[54px] rounded-t-md transition-all",
                      highlightLeader && i === 0
                        ? "bg-s4e-brand-primary-600"
                        : "bg-s4e-brand-primary-500",
                    )}
                    style={{ height: `${(b.value / computedMax) * 100}%` }}
                  />
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* X axis labels */}
        <div className="flex gap-2 sm:gap-6 pl-11">
          {data.map((b) => (
            <div key={b.label} className="flex-1 text-center text-[11px] text-s4e-text-secondary">
              {b.label}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  },
);
BarChart.displayName = "BarChart";

// ── Line / Area ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface LineChartProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  linePath:    string;
  yLabels?:    string[];
  xLabels?:    string[];
  showArea?:   boolean;
  gradientId?: string;
}

export const LineChart = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, LineChartProps>(
  (
    {
      linePath,
      yLabels = ["1500", "1000", "500", "0"],
      xLabels = [],
      showArea = true,
      gradientId,
      className,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    const reactId = React.useId();
    const fillId  = gradientId ?? `line-area-fill-${reactId.replace(/:/g, "")}`;
    const areaPath = `${linePath} L 100 100 L 0 100 Z`;

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role="img"
        aria-label={
          xLabels.length > 1
            ? `Line chart from ${xLabels[0]} to ${xLabels[xLabels.length - 1]}, range ${yLabels[yLabels.length - 1]} to ${yLabels[0]}`
            : "Line chart"
        }
        className={cn("relative", className)}
        {...props}
      >
        {/* Y axis labels */}
        <div className="absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-5 flex flex-col justify-between text-[10px] text-s4e-text-secondary">
          {yLabels.map((label) => (
            <span key={label}>{label}</span>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Chart */}
        <div className="ml-10">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" preserveAspectRatio="none" className="w-full h-40">
            <defs>
              <linearGradient id={fillId} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                <stop offset="0%"   stopColor="var(--s4e-brand-primary-500)" stopOpacity="0.28" />
                <stop offset="100%" stopColor="var(--s4e-brand-primary-500)" stopOpacity="0"    />
              </linearGradient>
            </defs>
            {[0, 33, 66, 100].map((y) => (
              <line
                key={y}
                x1="0"
                x2="100"
                y1={y}
                y2={y}
                stroke="var(--s4e-neutral-grey-200)"
                strokeWidth="0.3"
                strokeDasharray="1 1"
              />
            ))}
            {showArea && <path d={areaPath} fill={`url(#${fillId})`} />}
            <path
              d={linePath}
              fill="none"
              stroke="var(--s4e-brand-primary-500)"
              strokeWidth="0.9"
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
            />
          </svg>
        </div>

        {/* X axis labels */}
        {xLabels.length > 0 && (
          <div className="ml-10 mt-2 flex justify-between text-[10px] text-s4e-text-secondary">
            {xLabels.map((d) => (
              <span key={d} className="whitespace-nowrap">{d}</span>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  },
);
LineChart.displayName = "LineChart";

// ── Treemap ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type TreemapBlock = {
  label:    string;
  value:    number;
  color:    string;
  textOn?:  "accent" | "primary";
};

export interface TreemapChartProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  primary:    TreemapBlock[];
  secondary?: TreemapBlock[];
  height?:    number;
}

export const TreemapChart = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, TreemapChartProps>(
  ({ primary, secondary, height = 256, className, ...props }, ref) => {
    const renderBlock = (b: TreemapBlock) => (
      <div
        key={b.label}
        className={cn(
          "flex-1 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center text-[14px] font-semibold",
          b.textOn === "primary" ? "text-s4e-text-primary" : "text-s4e-text-on-accent",
        )}
        style={{ backgroundColor: b.color }}
      >
        {b.label} · {b.value}
      </div>
    );

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role="img"
        aria-label={summarize([...primary, ...(secondary ?? [])])}
        className={cn("flex gap-1", className)}
        style={{ height }}
        {...props}
      >
        {primary.map(renderBlock)}
        {secondary && secondary.length > 0 && (
          <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col gap-1">
            {secondary.map(renderBlock)}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  },
);
TreemapChart.displayName = "TreemapChart";
```

<!-- ===== Data Table (data-table) ===== -->

---
title: Data Table
slug: data-table
category: Organism
status: stable
source: components/ui/data-table.tsx
styleguide: /styleguide/data-table
figma: TBD
apg: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/table/
---

# Data Table

A composable card that lists findings (threat, asset, date, severity) with a header, column headers, rows and a pagination footer.

## Overview

### When to use
- Lists of findings or threats where users scan, compare and page through records.

### When not to use
- Fewer than ~5 items with rich content → a list of [Cards](./cards.md).
- Key/value details of one record → a description list.
- Arbitrary columns. This table currently has a **fixed threat-row schema** (see Known gaps).

## Anatomy

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ① Title  [badge]  ⓘ          description…        View all → │  DataTableHeader
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ ② THREATS ⓘ        ASSET ⓘ          DATE      SEVERITY        │  DataTableColumnHeaders
│ ③ SQL injection    example.com      12 Jun    ▮ High          │  DataTableRow
│   …                                                          │  DataTableBody (scroll)
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ ④ Row per page: 10 ▾          1–10 of 120        ‹  ›        │  DataTableFooter
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

Grid: `1fr 1fr 90px 80px`, gap 12px. Column headers are 11px uppercase.

## States

| Part | State | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| Body | `scroll` | Fixed-height, scrollable body with `minWidth` for horizontal scroll |
| Row | Hover | Row highlight |
| Header info | Hover | Tooltip with column / widget explanation |
| Table | Loading | Use [Skeleton](./skeleton.md) rows (not built in) |
| Table | Empty | Use [Empty State](./empty-state.md) `size="sm"` inside the body |

## Content guidelines
- Column headers: 1 word, uppercase is applied by CSS. Write them in sentence case in code.
- Dates: relative for < 7 days ("2 days ago"), absolute after that ("12 Jun 2026"). Show the full timestamp on hover.
- Truncate long asset names in the middle (`api.…example.com`), not at the end.

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Sort by severity by default | Default-sort by an internal ID |
| Pair the table with a [Filter Bar](./filter-bar.md) | Put filters inside column headers on mobile |

## Accessibility

**Pattern:** [APG — Table](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/table/)

- CSS-grid `<div>`s carry ARIA table roles: `DataTableBody` is `role="table"` (named by the header title via `aria-labelledby`), with `row`, `columnheader` and `cell` inside. Screen readers can navigate by row and column.
- Header and column info icons are focusable buttons (`aria-label="About <column>"`). The tooltip opens on hover **and** focus and closes on Escape.
- Row info icons only reveal truncated text on hover and are `aria-hidden`. The full text is already in the cell.
- The footer is `role="navigation"` labelled "Pagination", with "Previous page" / "Next page" labels; the range label is a polite live region.
- Severity uses colour + text ✅.

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Card border / surface | `s4e-border-default` / `s4e-surface-app` |
| Row hover / button hover | `s4e-bg-subtle` |
| Header text / body text | `s4e-text-secondary` / `s4e-text-primary` |
| Badge / link | `s4e-brand-primary-500/600` |
| Severity tints | `s4e-scale-{purple,red,yellow}-50/500/600` |
| Tooltip | `s4e-neutral-grey-900` / `s4e-text-inverse`, `shadow-s4e-lg` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma part | Component |
|---|---|
| Header | `DataTableHeader` (`title`, `description`, `badge`, `viewAllLabel`, `tooltip`) |
| Column header row | `DataTableColumnHeaders` (labels + tooltips) |
| Row | `DataTableRow` (`threat`, `asset`, `date`, `severity`) |
| Footer | `DataTableFooter` (`perPage`, `rangeLabel`) |

## API

| Component | Props |
|---|---|
| `DataTable` | div attrs (card wrapper) |
| `DataTableHeader` | `title: string`, `description: string`, `badge?`, `viewAllLabel?`, `onViewAll?`, `tooltip?` |
| `DataTableBody` | `scroll?: boolean`, `minWidth?: number` |
| `DataTableColumnHeaders` | `threatsLabel?`, `threatsTooltip?`, `assetLabel?`, `assetTooltip?`, `dateLabel?`, `severityLabel?` |
| `DataTableRow` | `threat: string`, `asset: string`, `date: string`, `severity: "high" \| "critical"` |
| `DataTableFooter` | `perPage?: number`, `rangeLabel?: string`, `onPrev?`, `onNext?` |

## Examples

```tsx
<DataTable>
  <DataTableHeader title="Top threats" description="Last 30 days" onViewAll={openAll} />
  <DataTableBody>
    <DataTableColumnHeaders />
    {rows.map((r) => <DataTableRow key={r.id} {...r} />)}
  </DataTableBody>
  <DataTableFooter rangeLabel="1–10 of 120" onPrev={prev} onNext={next} />
</DataTable>
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] Fixed 4-column threat schema. `severity` only accepts `high | critical`. A generic `columns` / `cells` API (or TanStack Table) is needed for reuse.
- [ ] No sorting, selection (with [Checkbox](./checkbox.md)), loading or empty states built in.
- [ ] The "Rows per page" button doesn't open anything yet.
- [ ] The default header tooltip text is placeholder copy.

## Related
- [Filter Bar](./filter-bar.md) · [Severity Badge](./severity-badge.md) · [Empty State](./empty-state.md) · [Skeleton](./skeleton.md)

### Source — `components/ui/data-table.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { Info, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, ChevronDown } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — DataTable
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/data-table.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 */

type Severity = "high" | "critical";

const SEVERITY_STYLES: Record<Severity, { label: string; bg: string; accent: string; text: string }> = {
  high: {
    label:  "High",
    bg:     "bg-s4e-scale-red-50",
    accent: "border-l-[3px] border-s4e-scale-red-500",
    text:   "text-s4e-scale-red-600",
  },
  critical: {
    label:  "Critical",
    bg:     "bg-s4e-scale-purple-50",
    accent: "border-l-[3px] border-s4e-scale-purple-500",
    text:   "text-s4e-scale-purple-600",
  },
};

export type DataTableProps = React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>;

// Lets DataTableBody (role="table") take its accessible name from the
// DataTableHeader title.
const DataTableContext = React.createContext<{ titleId: string } | null>(null);

export const DataTable = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, DataTableProps>(
  ({ className, children, ...props }, ref) => {
    const titleId = `${React.useId()}-title`;
    const context = React.useMemo(() => ({ titleId }), [titleId]);
    return (
      <DataTableContext.Provider value={context}>
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "border border-s4e-border-default rounded-xl bg-s4e-surface-app overflow-hidden",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
      </DataTableContext.Provider>
    );
  },
);
DataTable.displayName = "DataTable";

export interface DataTableHeaderProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  title:         string;
  description:   string;
  badge?:        string;
  viewAllLabel?: string;
  onViewAll?:    () => void;
  tooltip?:      string;
}

export const DataTableHeader = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, DataTableHeaderProps>(
  (
    {
      title,
      description,
      badge,
      viewAllLabel,
      onViewAll,
      tooltip = "Shortcut info about the widget — typically explains what powers this data.",
      className,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    const ctx = React.useContext(DataTableContext);
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "flex items-center gap-3 px-5 py-3 bg-s4e-bg-subtle border-b border-s4e-border-default rounded-t-xl",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
          <span id={ctx?.titleId} className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-s4e-text-primary">{title}</span>
          <InfoTooltip text={tooltip} label={`About ${title}`} />
        </div>
        <span className="text-[12px] text-s4e-text-secondary truncate flex-1 min-w-0">{description}</span>
        {badge && (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-s4e-bg-warning-subtle text-s4e-scale-yellow-700 text-[11px] font-medium shrink-0">
            <span aria-hidden className="w-[6px] h-[6px] rounded-full bg-s4e-scale-yellow-500" />
            {badge}
          </span>
        )}
        {viewAllLabel && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onViewAll}
            className="text-[12px] font-medium text-s4e-brand-primary-500 hover:text-s4e-brand-primary-600 transition-colors shrink-0 underline underline-offset-2"
          >
            {viewAllLabel}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  },
);
DataTableHeader.displayName = "DataTableHeader";

export interface DataTableBodyProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  scroll?:    boolean;
  minWidth?:  number;
}

export const DataTableBody = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, DataTableBodyProps>(
  ({ scroll = true, minWidth = 560, className, children, ...props }, ref) => {
    const ctx = React.useContext(DataTableContext);
    const inner = (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role="table"
        aria-labelledby={props["aria-label"] ? undefined : ctx?.titleId}
        style={scroll ? { minWidth } : undefined}
        className={cn(className)}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    );
    return scroll ? (
      <div className="overflow-x-auto s4e-scrollbar-hide">{inner}</div>
    ) : (
      inner
    );
  },
);
DataTableBody.displayName = "DataTableBody";

const GRID_COLS = "grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1fr)_90px_80px] gap-3";

export interface DataTableColumnHeadersProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  threatsLabel?:        string;
  threatsTooltip?:      string;
  assetLabel?:          string;
  assetTooltip?:        string;
  dateLabel?:           string;
  severityLabel?:       string;
}

export const DataTableColumnHeaders = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, DataTableColumnHeadersProps>(
  (
    {
      threatsLabel    = "Threats",
      threatsTooltip  = "Name of the detected threat, finding or CVE.",
      assetLabel      = "Asset",
      assetTooltip    = "The domain, IP or service the threat was found on.",
      dateLabel       = "Date",
      severityLabel   = "Severity",
      className,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role="row"
        className={cn(GRID_COLS, "px-5 py-2.5 border-b border-s4e-border-default", className)}
        {...props}
      >
        <div role="columnheader" className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-s4e-text-secondary uppercase tracking-wide">{threatsLabel}</span>
          <InfoTooltip text={threatsTooltip} label={`About ${threatsLabel}`} />
        </div>
        <div role="columnheader" className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-s4e-text-secondary uppercase tracking-wide">{assetLabel}</span>
          <InfoTooltip text={assetTooltip} label={`About ${assetLabel}`} />
        </div>
        <span role="columnheader" className="text-[11px] font-medium text-s4e-text-secondary uppercase tracking-wide text-right">{dateLabel}</span>
        <span role="columnheader" className="text-[11px] font-medium text-s4e-text-secondary uppercase tracking-wide text-right">{severityLabel}</span>
      </div>
    );
  },
);
DataTableColumnHeaders.displayName = "DataTableColumnHeaders";

export interface DataTableRowProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  threat:   string;
  asset:    string;
  date:     string;
  severity: Severity;
}

export const DataTableRow = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, DataTableRowProps>(
  ({ threat, asset, date, severity, className, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role="row"
        className={cn(
          GRID_COLS,
          "items-center px-5 py-3 border-b border-s4e-border-default last:border-b-0 hover:bg-s4e-bg-subtle/50 transition-colors",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <div role="cell" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
          <span className="text-[14px] text-s4e-text-primary truncate">{threat}</span>
          {/* Hover-only reveal of truncated text — AT already reads the full cell. */}
          <InfoTooltip text={threat} />
        </div>
        <div role="cell" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
          <span className="text-[14px] text-s4e-text-primary truncate">{asset}</span>
          <InfoTooltip text={asset} />
        </div>
        <span role="cell" className="text-[12px] text-s4e-text-secondary text-right tabular-nums">{date}</span>
        <div role="cell" className="flex justify-end">
          <SeverityCell severity={severity} />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  },
);
DataTableRow.displayName = "DataTableRow";

export interface DataTableFooterProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  perPage?:    number;
  rangeLabel?: string;
  onPrev?:     () => void;
  onNext?:     () => void;
}

export const DataTableFooter = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, DataTableFooterProps>(
  ({ perPage = 3, rangeLabel = "1–3 of 492", onPrev, onNext, className, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role="navigation"
        aria-label="Pagination"
        className={cn(
          "flex items-center justify-end gap-4 px-5 py-3 border-t border-s4e-border-default",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-[12px] text-s4e-text-secondary" aria-hidden>Rows per page:</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label={`Rows per page: ${perPage}`}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[12px] text-s4e-text-primary hover:text-s4e-brand-primary-500 transition-colors"
          >
            {perPage}
            <ChevronDown size={12} aria-hidden className="text-s4e-text-secondary" />
          </button>
        </div>
        <span className="text-[12px] text-s4e-text-secondary tabular-nums" aria-live="polite">{rangeLabel}</span>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onPrev}
            aria-label="Previous page"
            className="w-6 h-6 rounded hover:bg-s4e-bg-subtle flex items-center justify-center text-s4e-text-secondary hover:text-s4e-text-primary transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-s4e-focus-ring"
          >
            <ChevronLeft size={13} aria-hidden />
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onNext}
            aria-label="Next page"
            className="w-6 h-6 rounded hover:bg-s4e-bg-subtle flex items-center justify-center text-s4e-text-secondary hover:text-s4e-text-primary transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-s4e-focus-ring"
          >
            <ChevronRight size={13} aria-hidden />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  },
);
DataTableFooter.displayName = "DataTableFooter";

function SeverityCell({ severity }: { severity: Severity }) {
  const cfg = SEVERITY_STYLES[severity];
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex items-center justify-center rounded-md px-3 py-1 w-20", cfg.bg, cfg.accent)}>
      <span className={cn("text-[12px] font-medium", cfg.text)}>{cfg.label}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

// With a `label`, the icon is a focusable button that shows the tooltip on
// hover *and* focus (Escape hides it). Without one it's a decorative,
// mouse-only reveal for text that assistive tech can already read.
function InfoTooltip({ text, label }: { text: string; label?: string }) {
  const triggerRef = React.useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const tooltipId  = React.useId();
  const [show, setShow]     = React.useState(false);
  const [coords, setCoords] = React.useState({ top: 0, left: 0 });

  React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!show || !triggerRef.current) return;
    const rect = triggerRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    setCoords({
      top:  rect.top - 8,
      left: rect.left + rect.width / 2,
    });
  }, [show]);

  const bubble = show && (
    <span
      id={tooltipId}
      role={label ? "tooltip" : undefined}
      style={{ top: coords.top, left: coords.left }}
      className="fixed -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-full w-56 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-s4e-neutral-grey-900 text-s4e-text-inverse text-[11px] leading-relaxed pointer-events-none z-toast shadow-s4e-lg"
    >
      {text}
    </span>
  );
  const icon = (
    <Info size={13} aria-hidden className="text-s4e-text-secondary hover:text-s4e-text-primary shrink-0 cursor-help transition-colors" />
  );

  if (!label) {
    return (
      <span
        ref={triggerRef as React.RefObject<HTMLSpanElement>}
        aria-hidden
        className="inline-flex items-center shrink-0"
        onMouseEnter={() => setShow(true)}
        onMouseLeave={() => setShow(false)}
      >
        {icon}
        {bubble}
      </span>
    );
  }

  return (
    <button
      ref={triggerRef as React.RefObject<HTMLButtonElement>}
      type="button"
      aria-label={label}
      aria-describedby={show ? tooltipId : undefined}
      className="inline-flex items-center shrink-0 rounded focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-s4e-focus-ring"
      onMouseEnter={() => setShow(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() => setShow(false)}
      onFocus={() => setShow(true)}
      onBlur={() => setShow(false)}
      onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "Escape") setShow(false); }}
    >
      {icon}
      {bubble}
    </button>
  );
}
```

<!-- ===== Empty State (empty-state) ===== -->

---
title: Empty State
slug: empty-state
category: Organism
status: stable
source: components/ui/empty-state.tsx
styleguide: /styleguide/empty-state
figma: TBD
apg: N/A
---

# Empty State

Fills a region that has no content yet. It explains why it's empty and what to do next.

## Overview

### When to use
- First use ("No assets yet"), no results ("No findings match these filters"), cleared state ("All caught up"), or a recoverable error ("Couldn't load findings").

### When not to use
- Content is loading → [Skeleton](./skeleton.md).
- A page-level failure with no recovery → an error page.

## Anatomy

```
        ┌────┐
        │ ①  │       icon in tinted circle
        └────┘
     ② No findings yet
  ③ Run your first scan to see…
  ④ [Start scan]  ⑤ [Learn more]
```

1. **Icon** (required): any lucide-compatible component.
2. **Title** (required).
3. **Description** (optional).
4. **Primary action** (optional).
5. **Secondary action** (optional).

## Variants

| `tone` | Use for |
|---|---|
| `neutral` *(default)* | First use, no results |
| `warning` | Partial data, degraded state |
| `alert` | Failed to load (pair it with a retry action) |

## Sizes

| `size` | Icon box / icon | Title | Description | Padding (y) | Use for |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sm` | 40px / 18px | 14px | 12px | 32px | Inside cards and table bodies |
| `md` *(default)* | 56px / 24px | 15px | 14px | 48px | Full panels, pages |

## Content guidelines
- Title: state the situation plainly ("No findings match these filters").
- Description: one sentence on why, plus the next step.
- Primary action = the most likely next step ("Clear filters", "Start scan").

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Offer a way out (clear filters, create, retry) | Show "No data" with no action |
| Use `size="sm"` inside cards | Put a full-page empty state inside a small widget |

## Accessibility
- The title should be a real heading at the right level for its context (today it's a `<div>`; see Known gaps).
- The icon is decorative and should be `aria-hidden`.
- When the empty state appears after filtering, announce it in a polite live region ("No results").

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Container border / surface | `s4e-border-default` / `s4e-surface-app` |
| Icon circle (neutral / warning / alert) | `s4e-bg-subtle` / `s4e-bg-warning-subtle` + `-600` / `s4e-bg-error-subtle` + `-600` |
| Title / description | `s4e-text-primary` / `s4e-text-secondary` |
| Primary action | `s4e-brand-primary-500` (hover `-600`) / `s4e-text-white` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma property | Prop |
|---|---|
| Tone | `tone` = Neutral · Warning · Alert |
| Size | `size` = SM · MD |
| Primary / secondary button | `primaryAction`, `secondaryAction` |

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `icon` | `ComponentType<{ size?; className? }>` | — | **Required** |
| `title` | `string` | — | **Required** |
| `description` | `string` | — | — |
| `tone` | `"neutral" \| "warning" \| "alert"` | `"neutral"` | — |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md"` | `"md"` | — |
| `primaryAction` / `secondaryAction` | `{ label: string; icon?: Icon; onClick?: () => void }` | — | Rendered as buttons |

## Examples

```tsx
<EmptyState
  icon={SearchX}
  title="No findings match these filters"
  description="Try removing a filter or widening the date range."
  primaryAction={{ label: "Clear filters", onClick: clearAll }}
/>
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] Title is a `<div>`. Add a `headingLevel` prop (default `h3`).
- [ ] The action buttons are hand-styled instead of reusing [Button](./button.md), so they drift from the button tokens and lack `focus-visible`.
- [ ] The icon isn't `aria-hidden`.

## Related
- [Skeleton](./skeleton.md) · [Data Table](./data-table.md) · [Alert](./alert.md)

### Source — `components/ui/empty-state.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — EmptyState
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/empty-state.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 */

export type EmptyStateTone = "neutral" | "warning" | "alert";
export type EmptyStateSize = "sm" | "md";

export type EmptyStateAction = {
  label:    string;
  icon?:    React.ComponentType<{ size?: number; className?: string }>;
  onClick?: () => void;
};

export interface EmptyStateProps extends Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title"> {
  icon:              React.ComponentType<{ size?: number; className?: string }>;
  title:             string;
  description?:      string;
  tone?:             EmptyStateTone;
  size?:             EmptyStateSize;
  primaryAction?:    EmptyStateAction;
  secondaryAction?:  EmptyStateAction;
}

const TONE_ICON_WRAP: Record<EmptyStateTone, string> = {
  neutral: "bg-s4e-bg-subtle text-s4e-text-secondary",
  warning: "bg-s4e-bg-warning-subtle text-s4e-scale-yellow-600",
  alert:   "bg-s4e-bg-error-subtle text-s4e-text-error",
};

export const EmptyState = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, EmptyStateProps>(
  (
    {
      icon: Icon,
      title,
      description,
      tone = "neutral",
      size = "md",
      primaryAction,
      secondaryAction,
      className,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    const iconBox   = size === "sm" ? "w-10 h-10"   : "w-14 h-14";
    const iconSize  = size === "sm" ? 18            : 24;
    const titleSize = size === "sm" ? "text-[14px]" : "text-[15px]";
    const descSize  = size === "sm" ? "text-[12px]" : "text-[14px]";
    const pad       = size === "sm" ? "px-6 py-8"   : "px-6 py-12";

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center",
          pad,
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <div
          className={cn(
            "rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-4 shrink-0",
            iconBox,
            TONE_ICON_WRAP[tone],
          )}
        >
          <Icon size={iconSize} />
        </div>

        <div className={cn("font-semibold text-s4e-text-primary", titleSize)}>
          {title}
        </div>

        {description && (
          <p
            className={cn(
              "mt-1.5 max-w-sm text-s4e-text-secondary leading-relaxed",
              descSize,
            )}
          >
            {description}
          </p>
        )}

        {(primaryAction || secondaryAction) && (
          <div className="mt-5 flex items-center gap-2">
            {primaryAction && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={primaryAction.onClick}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-md bg-s4e-brand-primary-500 text-s4e-text-white text-[12px] font-medium hover:bg-s4e-brand-primary-600 transition-colors"
              >
                {primaryAction.icon && <primaryAction.icon size={13} />}
                {primaryAction.label}
              </button>
            )}
            {secondaryAction && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={secondaryAction.onClick}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-md border border-s4e-border-default bg-s4e-surface-app text-s4e-text-primary text-[12px] font-medium hover:bg-s4e-bg-subtle transition-colors"
              >
                {secondaryAction.icon && <secondaryAction.icon size={13} />}
                {secondaryAction.label}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  },
);
EmptyState.displayName = "EmptyState";
```

<!-- ===== Gauge (gauge) ===== -->

---
title: Gauge
slug: gauge
category: Organism
status: stable
source: components/ui/gauge.tsx
styleguide: /styleguide/gauge
figma: TBD
apg: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/meter/
---

# Gauge

A semicircular meter that shows a single value against a known maximum, such as a security score.

## Overview

### When to use
- One headline value on a bounded scale (Security score 72 / 100, coverage %).

### When not to use
- Comparing several values → a bar chart ([Chart](./chart.md)).
- Values without a meaningful maximum → a big-number `StatBlock` ([Chart](./chart.md)).
- Task progress over time → a progress bar.

## Anatomy

```
     ╭─ ① ticks ─╮
   ╭──────────────╮
  │ ② track ③ fill │
        ④ 72 / 100
```

1. **Ticks**: light / dark per colour.
2. **Track**: `*-100`.
3. **Fill**: `*-500`, proportional to `value / max`.
4. **Value label**: 14px bold value + 12px secondary "/ max".

## Variants

| `color` | Suggested meaning |
|---|---|
| `blue` *(default)* | Neutral metric |
| `green` | Good (e.g. score ≥ 80) |
| `yellow` | Fair |
| `red` | Poor |
| `purple` | Critical-related metric |

Pick the colour from **thresholds** documented with the metric, not by eye. Write the threshold table next to the screen spec.

## Content guidelines
- Always show the number. The arc alone isn't enough.
- Put the metric name above or below the gauge ("Security score").

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Use one gauge per card | Line up 6 gauges to compare values |
| Clamp `value` to `[0, max]` | Render negative or overflow values |

## Accessibility

**Pattern:** [APG — Meter](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/meter/)

- Today: the `<svg>` has `role="img"` and `aria-label="72 out of 100"`. ✅ It's announced.
- Better: `role="meter"` with `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin` and `aria-valuemax`, plus `aria-labelledby` pointing to the metric name, so screen readers say "Security score, 72".
- Colour isn't the only signal; the number is always visible ✅.

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Track | `s4e-scale-{blue,green,yellow,red,purple}-100` |
| Fill | `s4e-scale-*-500` |
| Ticks | `s4e-scale-*-200` / `s4e-scale-*-600` |
| Value / max | `s4e-text-primary` / `s4e-text-secondary` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma property | Prop |
|---|---|
| Color | `color` |
| Value / Max | `value`, `max` |

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `number` | — | **Required** |
| `max` | `number` | `100` | Upper bound |
| `color` | `"blue" \| "green" \| "yellow" \| "red" \| "purple"` | `"blue"` | Fill colour |
| …rest | `HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Forwarded |

## Examples

```tsx
<div>
  <h3 id="score-label" className="text-[12px] text-s4e-text-secondary">Security score</h3>
  <Gauge value={72} max={100} color={score >= 80 ? "green" : score >= 50 ? "yellow" : "red"} />
</div>
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] Use `role="meter"` + `aria-value*` and accept an accessible label prop.
- [ ] No threshold API (`thresholds={{ 50: "yellow", 80: "green" }}`), so colour logic is duplicated across screens.
- [ ] No size prop.

## Related
- [Chart](./chart.md) · [Cards](./cards.md)

### Source — `components/ui/gauge.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — Gauge
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/gauge.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 */

type GaugeColor = "blue" | "green" | "yellow" | "red" | "purple";

export interface GaugeProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  value:  number;
  max?:   number;
  color?: GaugeColor;
}

const TRACK_STROKE: Record<GaugeColor, string> = {
  blue:   "stroke-s4e-scale-blue-100",
  green:  "stroke-s4e-scale-green-100",
  yellow: "stroke-s4e-scale-yellow-100",
  red:    "stroke-s4e-scale-red-100",
  purple: "stroke-s4e-scale-purple-100",
};

const FILL_STROKE: Record<GaugeColor, string> = {
  blue:   "stroke-s4e-scale-blue-500",
  green:  "stroke-s4e-scale-green-500",
  yellow: "stroke-s4e-scale-yellow-500",
  red:    "stroke-s4e-scale-red-500",
  purple: "stroke-s4e-scale-purple-500",
};

const TICK_LIGHT_STROKE: Record<GaugeColor, string> = {
  blue:   "stroke-s4e-scale-blue-200",
  green:  "stroke-s4e-scale-green-200",
  yellow: "stroke-s4e-scale-yellow-200",
  red:    "stroke-s4e-scale-red-200",
  purple: "stroke-s4e-scale-purple-200",
};

const TICK_DARK_STROKE: Record<GaugeColor, string> = {
  blue:   "stroke-s4e-scale-blue-600",
  green:  "stroke-s4e-scale-green-600",
  yellow: "stroke-s4e-scale-yellow-600",
  red:    "stroke-s4e-scale-red-600",
  purple: "stroke-s4e-scale-purple-600",
};

function polar(cx: number, cy: number, r: number, deg: number) {
  const rad = (deg * Math.PI) / 180;
  return { x: cx + r * Math.cos(rad), y: cy + r * Math.sin(rad) };
}

function arcSegment(cx: number, cy: number, r: number, centerDeg: number, spanDeg: number) {
  const p0 = polar(cx, cy, r, centerDeg - spanDeg / 2);
  const p1 = polar(cx, cy, r, centerDeg + spanDeg / 2);
  return `M ${p0.x} ${p0.y} A ${r} ${r} 0 0 1 ${p1.x} ${p1.y}`;
}

export const Gauge = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, GaugeProps>(
  ({ value, max = 100, color = "blue", className, ...props }, ref) => {
    const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(value, max));
    const pct     = clamped / max;

    const W  = 170;
    const H  = 104;
    const cx = W / 2;
    const cy = H - 8;
    const r  = 68;
    const sw = 11;

    const arcPath = `M ${cx - r} ${cy} A ${r} ${r} 0 0 1 ${cx + r} ${cy}`;
    const needleAngle = -90 + pct * 180;

    const endAngle = -180 + pct * 180;
    const tickR    = r + sw * 1;
    const numDash  = 5;
    const gapDeg   = 6;
    const dashDeg  = (180 - (numDash - 1) * gapDeg) / numDash;
    const tickAngles = Array.from({ length: numDash }, (_, i) =>
      -180 + dashDeg / 2 + i * (dashDeg + gapDeg),
    );
    const ticks       = tickAngles.map((a) => arcSegment(cx, cy, tickR, a, dashDeg));
    const activeIndex = tickAngles.reduce(
      (best, a, i, arr) => (Math.abs(a - endAngle) < Math.abs(arr[best] - endAngle) ? i : best),
      0,
    );

    const pathLen = Math.PI * r;
    const drawn   = pct * pathLen;

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn("flex flex-col items-center w-[170px]", className)}
        {...props}
      >
        <svg
          width={W}
          height={H}
          viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
          overflow="visible"
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${value} out of ${max}`}
        >
          <path
            d={arcPath}
            fill="none"
            strokeWidth={sw}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            className={cn(TRACK_STROKE[color])}
          />

          <path
            d={arcPath}
            fill="none"
            strokeWidth={sw}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeDasharray={`${drawn} ${pathLen * 2}`}
            strokeDashoffset={drawn}
            className={cn(
              FILL_STROKE[color],
              "[animation:s4e-gauge-draw_1.1s_ease-out_forwards]",
            )}
          />

          <g>
            {ticks.map((d, i) => (
              <path
                key={i}
                d={d}
                fill="none"
                strokeWidth={3.5}
                strokeLinecap="round"
                className={cn(i === activeIndex ? TICK_DARK_STROKE[color] : TICK_LIGHT_STROKE[color])}
              />
            ))}
            <animate
              attributeName="opacity"
              from="0"
              to="1"
              dur="0.45s"
              begin="0.55s"
              fill="freeze"
            />
          </g>

          <g transform={`rotate(${needleAngle} ${cx} ${cy})`}>
            <path
              d={`M ${cx} ${cy - r * 0.72} L ${cx - 3} ${cy + 2} L ${cx + 3} ${cy + 2} Z`}
              className="fill-s4e-neutral-grey-500"
            />
            <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={3.5} className="fill-s4e-neutral-grey-600" />
            <animateTransform
              attributeName="transform"
              type="rotate"
              from={`-90 ${cx} ${cy}`}
              to={`${needleAngle} ${cx} ${cy}`}
              dur="1.1s"
              fill="freeze"
              calcMode="spline"
              keySplines="0.25 0.1 0.25 1"
            />
          </g>
        </svg>

        <div className="text-center -mt-2">
          <span className="font-bold text-s4e-text-primary text-[14px]">{value}</span>
          <span className="text-s4e-text-secondary text-[12px]"> / {max}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  },
);
Gauge.displayName = "Gauge";
```

<!-- ===== Modal (modal) ===== -->

---
title: Modal
slug: modal
category: Organism
status: stable
source: components/ui/modal.tsx
styleguide: /styleguide/modal
figma: TBD
apg: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/dialog-modal/
---

# Modal

A dialog that interrupts the current task to request a decision or focused input. It traps focus and blocks interaction with the rest of the page until it closes.

## Overview

### When to use
- Confirming a destructive or irreversible action ("Delete 3 assets?").
- A short, self-contained task that must finish before continuing (rename, quick create).

### When not to use
- Long forms or multi-step flows → a dedicated page.
- Non-blocking information → [Alert](./alert.md) or [Toast](./toast-tooltip.md).
- Content users need to reference while working on the page → a drawer / side panel (not built yet).

## Anatomy

```
░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░ ① backdrop ░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░
░  ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐   ░
░  │ ② Title                        ③ ✕  │   ░  ModalHeader
░  ├─────────────────────────────────────┤   ░
░  │ ④ Description / body                │   ░  ModalBody
░  │                                     │   ░
░  │              ⑤ [Cancel] [Delete]    │   ░  ModalFooter
░  └─────────────────────────────────────┘   ░
```

1. **Backdrop**: black/50 + blur. Clicking it closes the modal (`closeOnBackdrop`).
2. **Title**: `ModalTitle`, automatically the dialog's accessible name.
3. **Close**: `aria-label="Close"`.
4. **Body**: `ModalDescription` is automatically the accessible description. `scrollable` caps the height at 60vh.
5. **Footer**: right-aligned actions, primary last.

## Sizes

| `size` | Max width | Use for |
|---|---|---|
| `sm` *(default)* | 384px | Confirmations |
| `md` | 448px | Short forms |
| `lg` | 672px | Rich content, previews |

## States

| State | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Opening | Focus moves to the element with `data-autofocus`, else the first focusable element, else the panel |
| Open | Tab / Shift+Tab are trapped inside; body scroll is locked |
| Closing | Escape (`closeOnEscape`), backdrop click (`closeOnBackdrop`) or ✕ → `onOpenChange(false)` |
| Closed | Focus returns to the element that opened it |

## Content guidelines
- Title is a question or action for confirmations ("Delete 3 assets?").
- The body states the consequence ("This removes all scan history and can't be undone.").
- Button labels repeat the verb ("Delete", not "OK"); the secondary is "Cancel".

## Do / Don't

| ✅ Do | ❌ Don't |
|---|---|
| Put `data-autofocus` on the least destructive action for dangerous confirms | Auto-focus "Delete" |
| Set `closeOnBackdrop={false}` when there's unsaved input | Lose typed data on a stray click |
| Keep one modal at a time | Open a modal from a modal |

## Accessibility

**Pattern:** [APG — Dialog (Modal)](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/dialog-modal/)

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` | Cycle through focusable elements inside the modal only |
| `Escape` | Close (unless `closeOnEscape={false}`) |

- `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"` on the panel.
- `aria-labelledby` → `ModalTitle` and `aria-describedby` → `ModalDescription`, wired automatically. Pass `aria-label` if there's no visible title.
- Focus is restored to the trigger on close.

## Design tokens

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Panel / border | `s4e-surface-app` / `s4e-border-default` |
| Title / description | `s4e-text-primary` / `s4e-text-secondary` |
| Close hover / focus ring | `s4e-bg-subtle` / `s4e-focus-ring` |
| Layer | `z-modal` |

## Design ↔ Code

| Figma property | Prop |
|---|---|
| Size | `size` = SM · MD · LG |
| Header / Show close | `ModalHeader showClose` + `onClose` |
| Footer / Bordered | `ModalFooter bordered` |
| Body / Scrollable | `ModalBody scrollable` |

## API

| Component | Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Modal` | `open` | `boolean` | — (required) |
| | `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | — (required) |
| | `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"sm"` |
| | `closeOnBackdrop` | `boolean` | `true` |
| | `closeOnEscape` | `boolean` | `true` |
| `ModalHeader` | `onClose`, `showClose` | `() => void`, `boolean` | —, `true` |
| `ModalTitle` | span attrs | | |
| `ModalDescription` | p attrs | | |
| `ModalBody` | `scrollable` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `ModalFooter` | `bordered` | `boolean` | `false` |

## Examples

```tsx
<Modal open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
  <ModalHeader onClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
    <ModalTitle>Delete 3 assets?</ModalTitle>
  </ModalHeader>
  <ModalBody>
    <ModalDescription>This removes all scan history and can't be undone.</ModalDescription>
  </ModalBody>
  <ModalFooter>
    <Button intent="default" variant="outline" data-autofocus onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
    <Button intent="destructive" onClick={confirmDelete}>Delete</Button>
  </ModalFooter>
</Modal>
```

## Known gaps
- [ ] The rest of the page isn't marked `inert`, so screen-reader virtual cursors can still reach background content. Add `inert` to siblings of the portal root.
- [ ] No enter / exit animation.
- [ ] No alert-dialog variant (`role="alertdialog"`) for destructive confirms.

## Related
- [Button](./button.md) · [Alert](./alert.md)

### Source — `components/ui/modal.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { X } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * s4e/ui — Modal
 *
 * Drop this file into your project at components/ui/modal.tsx.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Tailwind CSS v4
 *   • cn() helper at @/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge)
 *   • s4e-* design tokens — grab tokens.css from the Theming page.
 *   • lucide-react (for the close icon)
 */

type Size = "sm" | "md" | "lg";

const SIZE_CLASS: Record<Size, string> = {
  sm: "max-w-sm",
  md: "max-w-md",
  lg: "max-w-2xl",
};

const FOCUSABLE =
  'a[href], button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), ' +
  'textarea:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"]), [contenteditable="true"]';

type ModalContextValue = {
  titleId:        string;
  descriptionId:  string;
  setHasTitle:       (v: boolean) => void;
  setHasDescription: (v: boolean) => void;
};

const ModalContext = React.createContext<ModalContextValue | null>(null);

export interface ModalProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  open:          boolean;
  onOpenChange:  (open: boolean) => void;
  size?:         Size;
  closeOnBackdrop?: boolean;
  closeOnEscape?:   boolean;
}

export const Modal = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ModalProps>(
  (
    {
      open,
      onOpenChange,
      size = "sm",
      closeOnBackdrop = true,
      closeOnEscape   = true,
      className,
      children,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    const [mounted, setMounted]         = React.useState(false);
    const [hasTitle, setHasTitle]       = React.useState(false);
    const [hasDescription, setHasDesc]  = React.useState(false);
    const panelRef                      = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    React.useImperativeHandle(ref, () => panelRef.current as HTMLDivElement);

    const autoId        = React.useId();
    const titleId       = `${autoId}-title`;
    const descriptionId = `${autoId}-description`;

    React.useEffect(() => { setMounted(true); }, []);

    // Escape to close + Tab focus trap.
    React.useEffect(() => {
      if (!open) return;
      const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
        if (e.key === "Escape" && closeOnEscape) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          onOpenChange(false);
          return;
        }
        if (e.key !== "Tab" || !panelRef.current) return;
        const nodes = Array.from(
          panelRef.current.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE),
        ).filter((el) => el.offsetParent !== null || el === document.activeElement);
        if (nodes.length === 0) {
          e.preventDefault();
          panelRef.current.focus();
          return;
        }
        const first = nodes[0];
        const last  = nodes[nodes.length - 1];
        const active = document.activeElement;
        if (e.shiftKey && (active === first || !panelRef.current.contains(active))) {
          e.preventDefault();
          last.focus();
        } else if (!e.shiftKey && (active === last || !panelRef.current.contains(active))) {
          e.preventDefault();
          first.focus();
        }
      };
      document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
      return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    }, [open, closeOnEscape, onOpenChange]);

    // Initial focus, focus restore and body scroll lock.
    React.useEffect(() => {
      if (!open || !mounted) return;
      const previouslyFocused = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
      const panel = panelRef.current;
      const target =
        panel?.querySelector<HTMLElement>("[data-autofocus], [autofocus]") ??
        panel?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE) ??
        panel;
      target?.focus();

      const { overflow } = document.body.style;
      document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";

      return () => {
        document.body.style.overflow = overflow;
        previouslyFocused?.focus?.();
      };
    }, [open, mounted]);

    const context = React.useMemo<ModalContextValue>(
      () => ({ titleId, descriptionId, setHasTitle, setHasDescription: setHasDesc }),
      [titleId, descriptionId],
    );

    if (!mounted || !open) return null;

    return createPortal(
      <div
        className="fixed inset-0 z-modal flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm"
        onClick={closeOnBackdrop ? () => onOpenChange(false) : undefined}
      >
        <ModalContext.Provider value={context}>
          <div
            ref={panelRef}
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-labelledby={hasTitle && !props["aria-label"] ? titleId : undefined}
            aria-describedby={hasDescription ? descriptionId : undefined}
            tabIndex={-1}
            className={cn(
              "relative w-full bg-s4e-surface-app border border-s4e-border-default rounded-xl shadow-xl focus:outline-none",
              SIZE_CLASS[size],
              className,
            )}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            {...props}
          >
            {children}
          </div>
        </ModalContext.Provider>
      </div>,
      document.body,
    );
  },
);
Modal.displayName = "Modal";

export interface ModalHeaderProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  onClose?: () => void;
  showClose?: boolean;
}

export const ModalHeader = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ModalHeaderProps>(
  ({ className, children, onClose, showClose = true, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-s4e-border-default",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
        {showClose && onClose && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close"
            className="w-7 h-7 rounded-md hover:bg-s4e-bg-subtle flex items-center justify-center text-s4e-text-secondary hover:text-s4e-text-primary transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-s4e-focus-ring"
          >
            <X size={15} aria-hidden />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  },
);
ModalHeader.displayName = "ModalHeader";

export type ModalTitleProps = React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>;

export const ModalTitle = React.forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, ModalTitleProps>(
  ({ className, children, id, ...props }, ref) => {
    const ctx = React.useContext(ModalContext);
    React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
      if (!ctx || id) return;
      ctx.setHasTitle(true);
      return () => ctx.setHasTitle(false);
    }, [ctx, id]);
    return (
      <span
        ref={ref}
        id={id ?? ctx?.titleId}
        className={cn("text-[14px] font-semibold text-s4e-text-primary", className)}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </span>
    );
  },
);
ModalTitle.displayName = "ModalTitle";

export type ModalDescriptionProps = React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>;

export const ModalDescription = React.forwardRef<HTMLParagraphElement, ModalDescriptionProps>(
  ({ className, children, id, ...props }, ref) => {
    const ctx = React.useContext(ModalContext);
    React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
      if (!ctx || id) return;
      ctx.setHasDescription(true);
      return () => ctx.setHasDescription(false);
    }, [ctx, id]);
    return (
      <p
        ref={ref}
        id={id ?? ctx?.descriptionId}
        className={cn("text-[14px] text-s4e-text-secondary leading-relaxed", className)}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </p>
    );
  },
);
ModalDescription.displayName = "ModalDescription";

export interface ModalBodyProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  scrollable?: boolean;
}

export const ModalBody = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ModalBodyProps>(
  ({ className, children, scrollable = false, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "px-5 py-5",
          scrollable && "max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    );
  },
);
ModalBody.displayName = "ModalBody";

export interface ModalFooterProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  bordered?: boolean;
}

export const ModalFooter = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ModalFooterProps>(
  ({ className, children, bordered = false, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "flex justify-end gap-2",
          bordered
            ? "px-5 py-3.5 border-t border-s4e-border-default"
            : "px-5 pb-4",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    );
  },
);
ModalFooter.displayName = "ModalFooter";
```

<!-- ===== Text Space (text-space) ===== -->

---
title: Text Space
slug: text-space
category: Organism
status: stable
source: components/ui/text-space.tsx
styleguide: /styleguide/text-space
figma: TBD
